Tagged union for holding an unsigned integer value of 8/16/32/64 bits. Useful for generic value passing where width varies.
80-bit unsigned integer composite with 64-bit low and 16-bit high parts. No arithmetic defined here; meant for manual big-integer style handling.
96-bit unsigned integer composite with 64-bit low and 32-bit high parts for extended-precision needs.
128-bit integer composite with 64-bit low and signed 64-bit high part, allowing signed magnitude in the high half.
256-bit integer composite made of two ut128 halves for very large integers.
Aggregate holding several extended-width integer representations (80/96/128/256-bit). Likely a convenience container for APIs handling multiple sizes.

objects.definition: typedef int (*RPVectorComparator)(const void *a, const void *b);
objects.description: Function pointer type for comparing two elements (as pointers) stored in an RPVector; must return negative/zero/positive like strcmp for ordering/sorting/search.

objects.definition: typedef void (*RVectorFree)(void *e, void *user);
objects.description: Function pointer type used by RVector to free or finalize an element. The first argument is a pointer to the element storage inside the vector; the second is the user data provided at vector init/new.

objects.definition: typedef void (*RPVectorFree)(void *e);
objects.description: Function pointer type used by RPVector to free or finalize the stored pointer element. Takes the actual pointer stored in the vector.

Dynamic array of arbitrary fixed-size elements. Stores raw contiguous storage (a), current length, capacity, element size, and an optional element-free callback plus its user data. Use r_vector_* APIs to manage lifetime and contents. Elements are copied from caller-provided memory blocks of size elem_size.

objects.definition: typedef struct r_pvector_t { RVector v; } RPVector;
objects.description: Type-safe dynamic array specialized for storing void* pointers. Internally wraps an RVector configured for pointer-sized elements and exposes pointer-centric helpers and semantics.

objects.definition: typedef void (*RListFree)(void *ptr);
objects.description: Function pointer type for per-element destructor used by RList. Called with each stored element pointer when purging/freeing or deleting nodes.
Doubly linked list node holding a generic data pointer and next/prev links. Used internally and exposed for iteration and node-level operations.
Generic doubly linked list container managing RListIter nodes. Stores head/tail pointers, optional element-free callback, current length, and a 'sorted' flag used by sorting/uniq helpers.

Composite range-like helper bundling a pointer hash (HtPP) and a list (RList). Exact semantics are not documented here; likely used to represent a range or selection mapped in a hash. HtPP is referenced but not defined in this header.

objects.definition: typedef int (*RListComparator)(const void *a, const void *b);
objects.description: Comparator callback returning -1, 0, or 1 to order two elements. Used by sorted insertion and sorting routines.

objects.definition: typedef int (*RListComparatorWithUser)(const void *a, const void *b, void *user);
objects.description: Comparator callback like RListComparator but with an extra opaque user context pointer.

objects.definition: typedef ut64 (*RListComparatorItem)(const void *a);
objects.description: Key-extractor callback that maps an item to a 64-bit key for uniqueness or ordering utilities.

objects.definition: typedef void *(*RListClone)(void *);
objects.description: Element cloning callback returning a duplicated element pointer, used by r_list_clone to deep-copy list contents.

Opaque-like regular expression handle used by this API. Holds compiled regex state (re_g points to internal guts), the number of capturing groups, flags, and optional end pointer for PEND mode. Intended to be constructed via r_regex_new or r_regex_init and freed with r_regex_free or r_regex_fini.
Match result record containing start (rm_so) and end (rm_eo) offsets for a single submatch, using signed 64-bit indices. Used with r_regex_exec and related helpers.

Command-line option parser state used by the r_getopt API. Holds parsing flags (err), current index (ind), last option character (opt), current option argument (arg), internal scan position (place), and the input argument vector/context (argc, argv, ostr). Intended to be initialized with r_getopt_init and advanced with r_getopt_next.
MD5 hashing context holding 128-bit state, bit count, and a 64-byte buffer. Used internally to compute MD5 digests.
SHA-1 hashing context with working buffers, message schedule, and size counters. Used to compute SHA-1 digests.
SHA-256 hashing context including 256-bit state, total bit count, and 64-byte block buffer.
SHA-512/384 base context with 512-bit state, 128-byte block buffer, and 128-bit total bit count split into two 64-bit words.

objects.definition: typedef RSha512Context RSha384Context;

Enumeration of value kinds used by the analysis/arch layer: register value, memory reference, or immediate. Alias provided for backward compatibility.

Holds a decoded operand/value description: type (reg/mem/imm), permissions, addressing attributes (segment, base, register, register-delta, multiplier), immediates, and offsets. Used by arch/analysis for operand modeling. Some field semantics are partially documented by comments.
Anonymous enum of assembly syntax options used by arch config and disassembly routines.

Configuration object describing architecture/decoder settings: arch/cpu/os, bitness, endian, syntax, alignments, addressing parameters, ABI, GP, and calling/float profile. Contains reference management via R_REF_TYPE. Used to drive arch sessions and plugins.
Bitmask enumeration controlling which analysis fields to populate during decoding (basic info, ESIL, value operands, hints, opex, disasm, or all).
Top-level architecture manager holding plugin registry, ESIL context, numeric helpers, the active session, default configuration, optional platform tag, and a user pointer.
Per-arch working context bound to a specific plugin and configuration. May reference a separate encoder session. Holds plugin-private data and user pointer. Reference-managed via R_REF_TYPE.
Enumeration of ESIL lifecycle actions passed to plugin ESIL callbacks: init, configure maps, reset, fini.

objects.description: Bitmask type for encode options passed to encoder callbacks. Underlying type is ut32.

objects.definition: typedef ut32 RArchModifyMask; // syntax ?
objects.description: Bitmask type for patch/modify options passed to modifier callbacks. Underlying type is ut32.

Plugin descriptor for an architecture backend. Contains metadata, supported triples (arch/cpus/endian/bits), and callback vtable for init/fini/info, register listing, encode/decode/patch, mnemonic tables, preludes, and ESIL actions.

Container for assembled or disassembled code. Holds byte sequence, textual assembly, name/value equates, offsets, alignment, and C floating profile. Used as the result of assemble/disassemble routines.

Parser configuration and helpers used to transform assembly/disassembly text: pseudo-instruction handling, substitutions (registers, RIP-relative, immediates), variable naming, and callbacks into analysis for flags/labels and register/pointer resolution.
Main assembler/disassembler context. Manages selected architecture/config, program counter, sessions, bindings to analysis/syscalls/nums, alignment, flags, and parse configuration.
Per-plugin session data bound to an RAsm instance. Holds back-pointer to RAsm, the plugin, and plugin-specific opaque data.
Plugin interface for assembly parsing helpers. Provides metadata and callbacks for pseudo-instruction expansion, filtering, subvar replacement, patching, and init/fini hooks.
DWARF .debug_line header (legacy/compact variant) capturing line program parameters and include/file tables for a unit.
Mutable line-state machine snapshot used while interpreting a DWARF line program.
Resolved address-to-source mapping entry with resolved file/path and line/column.
Internal compact address-to-source mapping entry using indices instead of strings.
DWARF-sized offset union that can hold either 32-bit or 64-bit section offsets depending on unit format.
DWARF type unit header describing standalone type units (DWARF4/5).
Header for a DWARF .debug_aranges contribution describing address range tables.
Abbreviation attribute definition entry: name, form, and optional special inline value.
Arbitrary DWARF block value with length and pointer to raw bytes.

Concrete attribute value paired with name/form and semantic kind; union holds the decoded data (address/const/flag/ref/block/string).
Parsed header for a DWARF compilation unit (CU/TU), including DWARF5 extensions and computed metadata.
In-memory representation of a DWARF DIE (Debugging Information Entry) with tag, abbrev code, attributes, and layout metadata.
A compilation unit consisting of a header and a dynamic array of DIEs parsed from .debug_info.
Container for all parsed .debug_info units with a lookup table keyed by DIE offset for quick access.
One abbreviation declaration mapping a code to a tag and a sequence of attribute definitions.
Parsed .debug_abbrev section: list of abbreviation declarations used by CUs/DIEs.
Decoded state machine registers used by DWARF line table execution (DWARFv3+ semantics).
Line table file-name entry with metadata and optional MD5 checksum.
DWARF v2–v5 line table header with decoded parameters, include directories, and file name table.
A single location list/range entry with start/end PC and an expression describing the location.
A collection of DWARF location ranges parsed from .debug_loc/.debug_loclists at a given section offset.

Top-level binary analysis context for radare2. Holds current file, plugin registries, IO and console bindings, configuration and options. Owns and manages RBinFile instances and interacts with format/loader/extractor plugins.
Enumeration of canonical special symbol slots (entry, init, main, fini, last index). Used to index RBinObject::binsym.

objects.description: Enumeration indicating relocation width (in bits).
Address tuple associating virtual/physical addresses and their high variants, with type and bitness metadata. Used for entries and special symbols.
Name container storing demangled, original, and flag-friendly representations of identifiers used across symbols, classes, fields, etc.
Represents a computed hash over a region (type, address/limits, data buffer preview, and command used).
Name/value pair for whole-file hashes (e.g., MD5/SHA256).
Aggregated metadata about a binary: format, arch, ABI, security features, hashes, addresses, interpreter, compiler, etc.
Generic symbol record unified across formats. Holds names, class/library association, addresses, size/ordinal, language/bits, and attribute flags.
Binary section/segment descriptor: name, sizes, V/P addresses, permissions/flags, format/arch metadata, and usage hints.
Imported symbol descriptor with origin library, binding/type info, class/descriptor, ordinal and some ELF-specific flags.
In-memory representation of a loaded binary object for a given architecture. Owns sections, imports, symbols, entries, classes, relocations, strings, info and plugin-specific internal object.
Options for opening/loading a binary file: plugin choice, addresses, size, which extracted member to load, file descriptor, string handling, and filename.
Pluggable storage and callbacks for address-to-source line mapping used by debug info integration.
Represents an opened binary file within RBin. Holds buffer, sizes, extractor state, SDB databases, address-line store, and the active RBinObject.
Options for creating/packaging a binary buffer via plugins, including code/data payloads and arch/bits.
Configuration toggles and limits controlling binary loading, demangling, string extraction, symbol limits, etc.
Metadata describing an extracted sub-binary: arch/bits, library name, machine and type, and extractor type string.
Container returned by extractor plugins holding a subfile buffer, its size/offset, base/load addresses, count info and metadata.
Plugin interface for archive/container extractors. Provides routines to detect, extract one or all members, and manage lifetime.
Loader plugin interface, used to load binaries via custom mechanisms (e.g., OS loaders).
Small struct to pass architecture and bitness settings to creation APIs.
Represents an exception handling region (try-catch) with bounds, handler, and optional filter address.
Format plugin interface: loads/parses specific binary formats and exposes entries, sections, symbols, imports, strings, info, etc., plus creation and utilities like demangling.
High-level class/type representation used for OO languages. Tracks name, supers, visibility, address, methods/fields, attributes, language and origin.
Relocation record describing type/width, target symbol or import, addend, addresses, visibility and ifunc semantics.
Extracted string item with addresses, ordinal, buffer size, logical length, and type character.
Kind enumeration for fields: plain variable, class/struct field, or property.
Describes a data field (variable/property) with address, size/offset, typed/name info, comments/format, and attributes.
Represents a memory mapping owned by the binary (name, base address, size, permissions) and mirror maps.
Mapping info for address-to-file offset with size/perms and filename. Used for segments/maps.
Function table attached to format plugins enabling write operations such as resizing sections, changing perms, removing rpath, changing entry, and adding libraries.
Binding structure for wiring bin-core callbacks (getters for offsets, names, sections, demangler, addrline, base address) into other components.

Descriptor for a single register: name, type/class, bit-size, offset within its arena, packed/register bank info, float flag, flags/comment metadata, index, arena id, read-only flag, and reference tracking macro.
A contiguous byte buffer representing a register bank storage area, with pointer to bytes and total size.
A group of registers of certain types. Holds an active arena, a pool of arenas (snapshots/stack), a list and hash of RRegItem, an iterator, and a bitmask of RRegType membership.

Top-level register file/context: stores profile strings, alias name table, an array of RRegSet for each register class, a list of all registers, read-only register spec, bit-capability mask, size/default bitness, endianness, and reference tracking.
Container for common CPU condition flags used by conditional evaluation routines (sign, zero, adjust, carry, overflow, parity).
Zone entry describing a named address interval with [from,to). Used to manage named zones for flags.
Container mapping a single address to the list of RFlagItem objects that start at that address. Typically stored in an address-sorted index.
Optional metadata attached to a flag item: user-visible type, color, comment, and an alias expression. Retrieved by id via r_flag_get_meta().
A single flag: named marker with address, size, and optional naming variants, assigned to a flag space.
Main flag manager holding collections and indexes of RFlagItem, zones, metadata, and spaces with synchronization and configuration fields.
Binding table of function pointers that expose the flag API to other components. Initialized via r_flag_bind_init and filled by r_flag_bind.

Filesystem context owning IO/core/console binds, registered filesystem plugins, mounted roots, the active view mask, and an opaque pointer. Central handle used by the R_FS API.

Filesystem file/entry descriptor used by FS plugins. Holds metadata (name/path/type/perm/time/uid/gid), data buffer info, offsets, plugin and root back-references, and an internal opaque pointer.
Mounted filesystem root instance bound to a plugin. Contains mount path, base offset (delta), plugin pointer, opaque pointer, and legacy IO/Core binds.
Filesystem plugin vtable and metadata. Provides operations for file open/read/write/dir, mount lifecycle, mkdir/unlink, command hook, and details printer.
Partition descriptor with number, start offset, length, index, and type code.
Interactive filesystem shell context wrapping console, current working directory, and line-editing callbacks.
Filesystem signature descriptor: name and byte/sequence match information used to identify filesystem types.

Partition map type descriptor containing a name, backend pointer and an iterator callback to enumerate partitions.
Anonymous enum of filesystem view flags controlling which entries are shown (normal, deleted, special, or all). Pointer type shown as int* because the enum is anonymous.

Handle for r2pipe/rap process or HTTP-backed command transport. On Unix it manages child pid and pipe fds; on Windows HANDLEs. Also embeds an RCoreBind for core integration and optional HTTP endpoint info.
Socket wrapper supporting TCP/UDP/UNIX/serial and optional OpenSSL state. Tracks fd, protocol, address, and SSL context objects when enabled.
Options controlling HTTP server accept/authorization behavior: tokens list, accept-timeout toggle and value, and HTTP auth requirement.
Subprocess I/O bridge used by socket layer: two pipe fd pairs and child pid.
Represents a parsed HTTP request received on an RSocket: metadata, payload, auth flag, and underlying socket.

Execution profile describing how to launch/configure a process: args, environment, sandboxes, limits, IO redirections, and radare2-specific toggles.

Represents a single system call entry from the database, including its name, software interrupt (swi), numeric identifier (num), argument count, and a string form of arguments. Lifecycle typically managed by helper APIs.
Associates a port number with a symbolic name for syscall-related I/O or service mappings. Likely used as auxiliary mapping inside the syscall context.
Main syscall context holding memoized target properties (arch, os, bits, cpu) and backing databases. Manages syscall items and port mappings. Reference-counted via refs.
Plugin descriptor for a syscall set for a given arch/os. Provides metadata and a pointer to argument specification array. Construction/destruction helpers are not defined in this header.
Plugin descriptor aggregating syscall argument specifications per-architecture, supporting multiple bitness values via bits[]. No direct constructors are declared here.

Holds vector of union members for a base type definition.

Simple linked list node for string key and long value attributes.
Central function object managed by analysis: names, type/callconv, entry address, variables, blocks, stack info, flags, fingerprint and owning RAnal.
Function argument metadata including name, format, calling-convention source, C type strings and size/source value.

Opaque container managing stored backtraces; details hidden behind priv.

Represents one access to a variable: base register, instruction offset, effective stackptr delta and permission flags.
Constraint on a variable value (condition type and constant). RAnalCondType defined elsewhere.
Variable instance (arg or local) within a function, including naming/type, location kind, stack/register location, access history and constraints.
Serializable prototype of a variable used for persistence/import without function binding.
Deprecated helper representing a sub-field reference inside a variable.
Function table installed by core to let modules call back into analysis services (mnemonics, encode/decode, hints, etc.).
Conditional expression object used to represent branch conditions; references decoded operand values.
Basic block node in CFG with address/size, edges (jump/fail), analysis annotations (condition, switch, fingerprint), instruction positions and membership list of functions.
One cross-reference from address 'at' to 'addr' with encoded type/perm/size in RAnalRefType.
Reference line visualization element from address to address including type, nesting level and direction.
Represents a frame in ESIL execution cycle stack with pending address, hook list and previous frame link.
Cycle hook descriptor capturing an address and number of cycles to wait/execute.
Token/word in ESIL representation with a type and string content.
ESIL control-flow graph container with start/end nodes and the underlying graph object.
80-bit like offset into ESIL expression stream: byte offset and intra-byte index.
Basic block over ESIL expressions with range, synthesized expression text and entry type tag.

Node in ESIL DFG with index, textual content and tag bitmask (const/var/ptr/result/etc.).
Small result struct for opflow callback indicating whether a jump table was detected.
Analysis plugin vtable carrying metadata, lifecycle hooks, op handlers, optional type parsers and diff/fp callbacks.
Typed data decoding result at an address: type/kind, pointer/number/string, buffer and small static buffer for short data.

Context for parsing RTTI/vtables: analysis handle, chosen C++ ABI, pointer size, and a callback to read addresses.
Parsed vtable descriptor containing start address and vector of method entries.
Method entry for class DB storing name, function address and optional virtual table offset.

Class attribute describing a vtable: its identifier, offset within the object, memory address and byte size.

struct r_magic {
	/* Word 1 */
	ut16 cont_level;	/* level of ">" */
	ut8 flag;

#define INDIR           0x01 /* if '(...)' appears */
#define OFFADD          0x02 /* if '>&' or '>...(&' appears */
#define INDIROFFADD     0x04 /* if '>&(' appears */
#define UNSIGNED        0x08 /* comparison is unsigned */
#define NOSPACE         0x10 /* suppress space character before output */
#define BINTEST         0x20 /* test is for a binary type (set only
                                for top-level tests) */
#define TEXTTEST        0    /* for passing to file_softmagic */

	ut8 dummy1;

	/* Word 2 */
	ut8 reln;		/* relation (0=eq, '>'=gt, etc) */
	ut8 vallen;		/* length of string value, if any */
	ut8 type;		/* comparison type (FILE_*) */
	ut8 in_type;	/* type of indirection */
#define FILE_INVALID        0
#define FILE_BYTE           1
#define FILE_SHORT          2
#define FILE_DEFAULT        3
#define FILE_LONG           4
#define FILE_STRING         5
#define FILE_DATE           6
#define FILE_BESHORT        7
#define FILE_BELONG         8
#define FILE_BEDATE         9
#define FILE_LESHORT        10
#define FILE_LELONG         11
#define FILE_LEDATE         12
#define FILE_PSTRING        13
#define FILE_LDATE          14
#define FILE_BELDATE        15
#define FILE_LELDATE        16
#define FILE_REGEX          17
#define FILE_BESTRING16     18

Top-level context for the magic engine. Holds the list of compiled magic entries, parsing/matching state (continuation levels, output buffers, offsets, errors), search parameters, a working VALUETYPE, and arrays for magic file names and formats.

Graph metrics for a function or code region: cyclomatic complexity (cc), number of basic blocks (nbbs), edges, exceptional basic blocks (ebbs), and a sum of BB sizes (bbsum). Used for graph-based signature matching.
Byte-pattern signature with size, pattern bytes, and a mask indicating which bytes are significant. Drives raw/analysis-derived byte matching.
Hash-based signature data. Currently stores a basic-block hash string (bbhash), typically computed via r_sign_calc_bbhash.

A complete signature record aggregating multiple facets: identifiers (name, realname, rawname, demangled, next), annotations (comment, types), namespace space, metric/byte/hash sub-objects, address, and relation lists (refs, xrefs, collisions, vars). Core unit stored/searched by the sign subsystem.

Configuration and state for metric-based signature matching across functions: which signature types to consider, minimal complexity/size thresholds, owning RAnal, user payload, and the per-match callback.
Search context for streaming/online byte-pattern scanning. Holds an RSearch engine, item list, callback, and user data.
Options controlling diff/matching thresholds for bytes and graph metrics in signature comparison operations.

Enum return type for thread functions indicating lifecycle control (stop, repeat, pause) and a freed state. Used as the return value of RThreadFunction callbacks.

Semaphore wrapper around platform-specific semaphore/handle type R_TH_SEM_T. Used for synchronization within thread channels and other primitives.
Enumeration describing how an RThreadLock was allocated (static or heap). Aids in correct destruction/management semantics.

Mutex/lock wrapper with state. Contains an atomic flag (activating), an active flag, an allocation type, and the underlying platform lock R_TH_LOCK_T. Use r_th_lock_new/enter/leave/free for lifecycle and usage.
Condition variable wrapper around platform-specific R_TH_COND_T. Works with RThreadLock for signaling and waiting.

Thread object containing OS thread identifier, a lock, the entry function, user pointer, and state flags. Create with r_th_new, start with r_th_start, wait/kill/break via provided APIs, and free with r_th_free or r_th_kill_free.
Simple thread pool structure holding a count and an array of RThread pointers. No direct API constructors in this header.

Message-passing channel between producer and consumer threads. Maintains queues (stack/responses), synchronization primitives (lock/sem), and a consumer RThread. Use r_th_channel_new/free and message APIs for operations.
Message object passed through RThreadChannel. Contains an identifier, payload buffer and length, and per-message synchronization primitives.
Promise/future-like handle to await a response for a channel query. Associates an ID with a message and its channel. Use r_th_channel_promise_new/wait/free and r_th_channel_query/post to manage.
Enumeration describing maturity/quality levels of a plugin. Used to express how complete or reliable a plugin is.

Metadata container for a plugin, including human-readable information (name, description, author, version, license, contacts, copyright) and its status. Memory management for the strings is not defined here; typically the plugin provides and frees them.

Describes an ESIL operation: handler callback, stack effects (push/pop), type flags, and info string.

Alias type representing the ptrace request code. On glibc systems it aliases the system enum __ptrace_request; otherwise it is a size_t. Used to specify which ptrace operation to perform. Exact underlying values depend on platform/libc and are not defined in this header.
Enumeration of internal request kinds handled by the ptrace-wrap worker thread: stop the worker, perform a ptrace call, perform a fork with a child callback, or run an arbitrary function.

objects.definition: typedef void *(*ptrace_wrap_func_func)(void *);
