functions.name: r_bin_bind
functions.description: Binds external helpers/callbacks to the RBin instance using the RBinBind structure (demangling, section queries, etc.).
requirements: b must be a valid RBin.
bnd must be a valid pointer to a filled RBinBind structure; fields not set may remain NULL if optional.

functions.name: r_bin_plugin_add
functions.description: Registers a bin format plugin with the RBin instance.
requirements: bin must be valid.
plugin must be a valid plugin structure; callbacks should be correctly set for use.
Returns true on success; false on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_plugin_remove
functions.description: Unregisters a previously added bin plugin from the RBin instance.
requirements: bin must be valid.
plugin must be a reference to a plugin previously added to bin.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_xtr_add
functions.description: Registers an extraction (xtr) plugin with the RBin instance for container/extractor formats.
requirements: bin must be valid.
foo must be a valid RBinXtrPlugin structure.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_ldr_add
functions.description: Registers a loader plugin with the RBin instance.
requirements: bin must be valid.
foo must be a valid RBinLdrPlugin.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_list
functions.description: Lists information about the current binary/binaries into a PJ (JSON) printer with a format selector.
requirements: bin must be valid.
pj may be NULL or a valid PJ printer context depending on usage.
format controls the output mode; exact values are implementation-defined.

functions.name: r_bin_list_plugin
functions.signature: bool r_bin_list_plugin(RBin *bin, const char *name, PJ *pj, int json);
functions.description: Lists details about a specific plugin by name, writing into PJ optionally as JSON.
requirements: bin must be valid.
name should be a plugin name string.
pj may be NULL or a valid printer context.
json is a flag (non-zero to output JSON if supported).
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_get_binplugin_by_buffer
functions.description: Detects and returns a bin plugin suitable for a buffer’s content, optionally using the binfile context.
requirements: bin must be valid.
buf must be a valid buffer with binary content.
bf may be NULL or a valid RBinFile context.
Returns NULL if no plugin matches.

functions.name: r_bin_force_plugin
functions.description: Forces the RBin instance to use a specific plugin by name for subsequent operations.
requirements: bin must be valid.
pname must be a valid plugin name string known to the system.

functions.name: r_bin_get_baddr
functions.description: Returns the base virtual address for the currently selected binary.
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_file_get_baddr
functions.description: Returns the base virtual address for a specific RBinFile.
requirements: bf must be a valid RBinFile.

functions.name: r_bin_set_user_ptr
functions.description: Associates a user-defined pointer with the RBin instance for client use.
requirements: bin must be valid.
user may be any pointer; lifetime is managed by caller.

functions.name: r_bin_get_info
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the RBinInfo describing the currently selected binary.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL if no binary is loaded.

functions.name: r_bin_set_baddr
functions.description: Sets the base virtual address for the RBin instance (affects address calculations).
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_get_laddr
functions.description: Returns the current load address (physical/file-based) for the selected binary, if applicable.
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_get_size
functions.description: Returns the size of the currently selected binary in bytes.
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_get_sym
functions.description: Returns a pointer to a special symbol address (entry/main/init/fini) by enum index RBinSym value.
requirements: bin must be valid.
sym must be a valid index of R_BIN_SYM_* (0..R_BIN_SYM_LAST-1).
Return may be NULL if the symbol is unavailable.

functions.name: r_bin_raw_strings
functions.description: Scans and returns a list of raw strings found in the specified binfile, with a minimum length filter.
requirements: a must be a valid RBinFile.
min is the minimum string length (in characters) to include; must be non-negative.
Returns a list (possibly empty) or NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_dump_strings
functions.description: Scans and returns strings for the specified binfile, optionally controlling raw mode via the raw flag.
requirements: a must be a valid RBinFile.
min is minimum string length; must be non-negative.
raw is a flag toggling raw string behavior (exact semantics unspecified).

functions.name: r_bin_get_entries
functions.description: Returns a list of entry points for the current binary (read-only list).
requirements: bin must be valid.
Returned list may be NULL if not available; do not modify or free it.

functions.name: r_bin_get_imports
functions.description: Returns a list of imports for the current binary (read-only list).
requirements: bin must be valid.
Returned list may be NULL and is owned by the bin; do not modify or free.

functions.name: r_bin_get_libs
functions.description: Returns a list of libraries the current binary depends on.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Caller should treat returned list ownership according to implementation (unknown); if in doubt, consult API usage elsewhere.

functions.name: r_bin_patch_relocs
functions.description: Applies and/or returns patched relocations for the given binfile.
requirements: bin must be a valid RBinFile.
Returns a pointer to a relocation tree or NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_get_relocs
functions.description: Returns the relocations tree for the current binary.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL if not available.

functions.name: r_bin_get_sections
functions.description: Returns a list of sections for the current binary.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL or an empty list.

functions.name: r_bin_get_classes
functions.description: Returns a list of class metadata objects for the current binary (if class-aware format).
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL if not available.

functions.name: r_bin_get_types
functions.description: Returns a textual representation of discovered types for the current binary.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL on failure. Ownership of returned string is with caller (free when done) if allocated.

functions.name: r_bin_get_strings
functions.description: Returns the list of strings discovered for the current binary (based on bin options).
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL or an empty list.

functions.name: r_bin_file_get_trycatch
functions.description: Returns try/catch metadata for exception-aware formats (e.g., Java, .NET) from a specific binfile.
requirements: bf must be valid.
Return may be NULL if not available.

functions.name: r_bin_get_symbols
functions.description: Returns the list of symbols for the current binary (deprecated in favor of vector in some versions).
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL or empty.

functions.name: r_bin_get_symbols_vec
functions.description: Returns a vector (RVec) of symbols for the current binary for better performance/memory usage.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL or an empty vector.

functions.name: r_bin_reset_strings
functions.description: Rescans or resets strings in the current binary and returns the (re)built list.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_is_big_endian
functions.description: Returns endianness of the current binary. May return -1 (unknown), 0 (little), or 1 (big).
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_is_static
functions.description: Returns whether the current binary is statically linked (API marked as deprecated).
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_get_vaddr
functions.signature: ut64 r_bin_get_vaddr(RBin *bin, ut64 paddr, ut64 vaddr);
functions.description: Translates a physical/file address to a virtual address (or validates vaddr) using the current binary’s mapping rules.
requirements: bin must be valid.
paddr and vaddr are inputs; exact precedence/behavior depends on plugin.

functions.name: r_bin_file_get_vaddr
functions.signature: ut64 r_bin_file_get_vaddr(RBinFile *bf, ut64 paddr, ut64 vaddr);
functions.description: Translates addresses using a specific binfile's mappings.
requirements: bf must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_file_get_vaddr
functions.signature: ut64 r_bin_file_get_vaddr(RBinFile *bf, ut64 paddr, ut64 vaddr);
functions.description: Translates/validates addresses similar to r_bin_get_vaddr but for a specific binfile.
requirements: bf must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_load_languages
functions.description: Loads language information/metadata for the given binfile, if supported.
requirements: binfile must be valid.
Returns an integer status; specific codes unspecified (non-zero typically success or count).

functions.name: r_bin_cur
functions.description: Returns the current/selected RBinFile within the RBin handle.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL if none selected.

functions.name: r_bin_cur_object
functions.description: Returns the current/selected RBinObject for the current binfile.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL if not available.

functions.name: r_bin_select
functions.signature: bool r_bin_select(RBin *bin, const char *arch, int bits, const char *name);
functions.description: Selects a binary object by architecture, bitness, and optional name within the RBin instance.
requirements: bin must be valid.
arch should be a supported architecture string.
bits should be valid for the architecture.
name may be NULL or a specific object name.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_select_bfid
functions.description: Selects the current binfile by its internal id.
requirements: bin must be valid.
bf_id must correspond to an existing binfile id.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_use_arch
functions.signature: bool r_bin_use_arch(RBin *bin, const char *arch, int bits, const char *name);
functions.description: Configures the RBin instance to use a specific architecture/bitness/name combination, affecting analysis and decoding.
requirements: bin must be valid.
arch must be a recognized architecture string; bits should be supported values.
name may be NULL.
Returns true on success; false on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_list_archs
functions.signature: void r_bin_list_archs(RBin *bin, PJ *pj, RTable *t, int mode);
functions.description: Outputs the list of available architectures/variants into PJ or RTable according to mode.
requirements: bin must be valid.
pj and/or t may be NULL depending on output mode.
mode selects output sink/format; exact values are implementation-defined.

functions.name: r_bin_create
functions.signature: RBuffer *r_bin_create(RBin *bin, const char *plugin_name, const ut8 *code, int codelen, const ut8 *data, int datalen, RBinArchOptions *opt);
functions.description: Creates a new binary image using a specified plugin from provided code/data buffers and arch options, returning it as an RBuffer.
requirements: bin must be valid.
plugin_name must specify a creation-capable plugin.
code may be NULL or a pointer to code bytes with length codelen (>=0).
data may be NULL or a pointer to data bytes with length datalen (>=0).
opt must be a valid pointer to initialized RBinArchOptions.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_package
functions.signature: RBuffer *r_bin_package(RBin *bin, const char *type, const char *file, RList *files);
functions.description: Packages files into a container/binary of a given type, returning the produced buffer.
requirements: bin must be valid.
type must identify a supported package type.
file may be a base filename or template; semantics plugin-defined.
files must be a valid list of inputs to package.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_string_type
functions.description: Returns a textual description of a string type code (e.g., ASCII, UTF8, WIDE).
requirements: type must be one of RStringType codes (or compatible); unknown values may return a default or NULL.

functions.name: r_bin_entry_type_string
functions.description: Returns a textual description of an entry type constant (program/main/init/fini/tls/preinit).
requirements: etype should be one of R_BIN_ENTRY_TYPE_* constants; unknown values may return NULL.

functions.name: r_bin_file_object_new_from_xtr_data
functions.signature: bool r_bin_file_object_new_from_xtr_data(RBin *bin, RBinFile *bf, ut64 baseaddr, ut64 loadaddr, RBinXtrData *data);
functions.description: Creates and attaches a new RBinObject to a binfile using previously extracted container data.
requirements: bin must be valid.
bf must be a valid RBinFile belonging to bin.
data must be a valid RBinXtrData produced by an xtr plugin.
baseaddr and loadaddr set mapping addresses; valid address values required.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_file_close
functions.description: Closes a binfile referenced by a descriptor/index within the RBin instance.
requirements: bin must be valid.
bd must identify an open binfile.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_file_free
functions.description: Frees an RBinFile object passed as void* for use as a generic free callback.
requirements: bf_ must be NULL or point to a valid RBinFile previously allocated/owned by RBin.
Do not use the object after freeing.

functions.name: r_bin_file_at
functions.description: Returns the RBinFile that contains the given address, if any.
requirements: bin must be valid.
addr is an address to query within currently loaded binfiles.
Returns NULL if no binfile matches.

functions.name: r_bin_file_find_by_object_id
functions.description: Finds a binfile by its internal object id.
requirements: bin must be valid.
binobj_id must reference an existing RBinObject id.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: r_bin_file_get_symbols
functions.description: Returns a list of symbols associated with the specified binfile.
requirements: bf must be valid.
Return may be NULL or an empty list.

functions.name: r_bin_file_get_symbols_vec
functions.description: Returns a vector of symbols for the specified binfile.
requirements: bf must be valid.
Return may be NULL.

functions.name: r_bin_file_add_class
functions.signature: RBinClass *r_bin_file_add_class(RBinFile *binfile, const char *name, const char *super, ut64 attr);
functions.description: Adds a class definition to the given binfile and returns the created class object.
requirements: binfile must be valid.
name should be a non-NULL class name.
super may be NULL.
attr is a bitmask of RBinAttribute flags.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_file_add_method
functions.signature: RBinSymbol *r_bin_file_add_method(RBinFile *bf, const char *rawname, const char *classname, const char *name, int nargs);
functions.description: Adds a method symbol to the specified class within a binfile and returns the symbol.
requirements: bf must be valid.
rawname may be a mangled/original name; must be a valid string if provided.
classname should be a valid existing class name in the binfile.
name should be a method name string.
nargs is the number of arguments; must be >= 0.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_file_add_field
functions.description: Adds a field to the specified class within a binfile and returns the field object.
requirements: binfile must be valid.
classname should reference an existing class name.
name should be a non-NULL field name.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_file_find_by_arch_bits
functions.description: Finds and returns a binfile loaded in RBin matching the given architecture and bitness.
requirements: bin must be valid.
arch should be a supported architecture string.
bits should be valid for that architecture.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: r_bin_file_find_by_id
functions.description: Finds a binfile by its binfile id within RBin.
requirements: bin must be valid.
bin_id must exist; returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: r_bin_file_find_by_fd
functions.description: Finds a binfile by its associated file descriptor.
requirements: bin must be valid.
bin_fd should be a file descriptor previously used to open a binfile.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: r_bin_file_find_by_name
functions.description: Finds a binfile by its name/path within the RBin instance.
requirements: bin must be valid.
name must be a non-NULL string to match.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: r_bin_file_set_cur_binfile
functions.description: Sets the current binfile in the RBin instance to the provided handle.
requirements: bin must be valid.
bf must be a binfile belonging to bin.
Returns true on success; false on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_file_set_cur_by_name
functions.description: Selects the current binfile by matching its name.
requirements: bin must be valid.
name must be a non-NULL string.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_file_deref
functions.description: Decrements reference or otherwise dereferences the specified binfile from RBin. May trigger close/free when refcount reaches zero.
requirements: bin must be valid.
a must be a valid RBinFile associated with bin.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_file_set_cur_by_fd
functions.description: Selects the current binfile by its file descriptor.
requirements: bin must be valid.
bin_fd must identify an existing binfile.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_file_set_cur_by_id
functions.description: Selects the current binfile by its binfile id.
requirements: bin must be valid.
bin_id must exist.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_file_delete_all
functions.description: Deletes all binfiles from the RBin instance and returns a count or status as ut64.
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_file_delete
functions.description: Deletes a single binfile by id from the RBin instance.
requirements: bin must be valid.
bin_id must refer to an existing binfile.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_file_merge
functions.description: Merges metadata/items from binfile b into binfile bo.
requirements: bo and b must be valid RBinFile pointers.
Behavior when merging conflicting data is implementation-defined.

functions.name: r_bin_file_compute_hashes
functions.description: Computes file-level hashes up to a size limit and returns a list of RBinFileHash entries.
requirements: bin must be valid.
limit is a byte limit; must be >= 0 (ut64).
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_file_set_hashes
functions.description: Sets or replaces the current file hash list with the provided list, returning the list (or previous).
requirements: bin must be valid.
new_hashes must be a list of RBinFileHash items prepared by caller.
Ownership/transfer semantics are implementation-defined.

functions.name: r_bin_file_cur_plugin
functions.description: Returns the currently selected bin plugin for a given binfile.
requirements: binfile must be valid.
Return may be NULL if not set.

functions.name: r_bin_file_hash_free
functions.description: Frees an RBinFileHash structure.
requirements: fhash may be NULL or a valid pointer to RBinFileHash.
Do not use after freeing.

functions.name: r_bin_object_set_items
functions.description: Sets the object’s discovered items (sections/symbols/imports/etc.) into the given binfile context.
requirements: binfile must be valid.
o must be a valid RBinObject with its vectors/lists prepared.
Returns an int status; exact codes unspecified.

functions.name: r_bin_object_delete
functions.description: Deletes/removes the RBinObject associated with the specified binfile id from the RBin instance.
requirements: bin must be valid.
binfile_id must exist.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_mem_free
functions.description: Frees an RBinMem object passed as a generic pointer.
requirements: data may be NULL or point to a valid RBinMem.
Do not use after freeing.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle
functions.signature: char *r_bin_demangle(RBinFile *binfile, const char *lang, const char *str, ut64 vaddr, bool libs);
functions.description: Demangles a symbol name according to a specified language and context, returning a newly allocated string.
requirements: binfile must be valid (used for context/path for helpers).
lang is a language selector string; may be NULL for auto-detection.
str must be a non-NULL mangled name.
vaddr may hint for language resolution; exact semantics unspecified.
libs indicates whether to use external libraries; exact behavior depends on options.
Returns NULL on failure; caller should free the returned string when non-NULL.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_java
functions.description: Demangles Java-style names to a human-readable form.
requirements: str must be a non-NULL string.
Returns newly allocated string or NULL on failure; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_freepascal
functions.description: Demangles FreePascal-style symbols.
requirements: str must be non-NULL.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_cxx
functions.description: Demangles C++ (Itanium/MSVC depending on context) symbol names using binfile context.
requirements: binfile must be valid.
str must be non-NULL.
vaddr may be used to resolve context; semantics unspecified.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_msvc
functions.description: Demangles MSVC (Visual C++)-mangled names.
requirements: str must be non-NULL.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_swift
functions.signature: char *r_bin_demangle_swift(const char *s, bool syscmd, bool trylib);
functions.description: Demangles Swift symbol names, optionally using system command or library.
requirements: s must be non-NULL.
syscmd toggles using an external system command.
trylib toggles trying a demangling library.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_objc
functions.description: Formats/demangles Objective-C symbol names using binfile context.
requirements: binfile must be valid.
sym must be non-NULL.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_rust
functions.description: Demangles Rust symbol names using binfile context and optional address hint.
requirements: binfile must be valid.
str must be non-NULL.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_type
functions.description: Detects the likely mangling type for a given string and returns an integer code.
requirements: str must be non-NULL.
Return value is an int representing type; codes are library-defined.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_list
functions.description: Lists available demangling plugins/types within the RBin instance (likely printing via console bindings).
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_demangle_plugin
functions.description: Demangles using a specific demangling plugin by name and returns the result string.
requirements: bin must be valid.
name must be a plugin name string.
str must be a non-NULL mangled name.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_get_meth_flag_string
functions.description: Returns a textual description of method attributes/flags; optionally compact representation.
requirements: flag is a bitmask of RBinAttribute or method flags.
compact toggles shorter representation.
Return may be NULL for unknown flags.

functions.name: r_bin_get_section_at
functions.description: Finds and returns the section within the object at the given offset, interpreting it as virtual (va!=0) or physical (va==0).
requirements: o must be a valid RBinObject.
off is the address/offset to query.
va controls address space: non-zero for vaddr, zero for paddr.
Returns NULL if no matching section.

functions.name: r_bin_addrline_reset
functions.description: Resets the internal address-to-source line store for the RBin instance.
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_addrline_reset_at
functions.description: Resets/invalidates addr->line information at a specific address.
requirements: bin must be valid.

functions.name: r_bin_addrline_foreach
functions.description: Iterates over stored addr->line entries, invoking a callback for each.
requirements: bin must be valid.
item must be a valid callback function; it is called with user pointer.
Returns true on full iteration; false if aborted or on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_addrline_files
functions.description: Returns a list of source file entries known to the address-line mapping.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL or empty.

functions.name: r_bin_addrline_at
functions.description: Returns the address-line info for a specific address if available.
requirements: bin must be valid.
addr is the query address.
Return may be NULL if unknown.

functions.name: r_bin_addrline_free
functions.description: Frees an RBinAddrline record.
requirements: di may be NULL or a valid pointer to RBinAddrline.
Do not use after freeing.

functions.name: r_bin_addrline_get
functions.description: Gets (possibly creating/resolving) the addr->line information for the given address.
requirements: bin must be valid.
addr is the query address.
Return may be NULL if not resolvable.

functions.name: r_bin_addrline_tostring
functions.description: Formats the addr->line info for an address into a human-readable string.
requirements: bin must be valid.
addr is the query address.
origin selects which info to render; specifics unspecified.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_wr_addlib
functions.description: Adds a library dependency to the currently loaded binary (write/patch operation).
requirements: bin must be valid and opened in a context that supports writing/patching.
lib must be a non-NULL library name string.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_wr_scn_resize
functions.signature: ut64 r_bin_wr_scn_resize(RBin *bin, const char *name, ut64 size);
functions.description: Resizes a section by name in the current binary and returns the resulting size or status.
requirements: bin must be valid and writable for the format.
name must be a non-NULL existing section name.
size is the new size in bytes.
Return value semantics are plugin/format-dependent.

functions.name: r_bin_wr_scn_perms
functions.signature: bool r_bin_wr_scn_perms(RBin *bin, const char *name, int perms);
functions.description: Changes section permissions by name in the current binary.
requirements: bin must be valid and writable for the format.
name must be a non-NULL existing section name.
perms must be a valid permission bitmask for the format.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_wr_rpath_del
functions.description: Removes RPATH from the current binary if supported.
requirements: bin must be valid and writable for the format.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_wr_entry
functions.description: Sets/patches the entry point address of the current binary.
requirements: bin must be valid and writable for the format.
addr must be a valid executable address for the target binary.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_wr_output
functions.description: Writes the modified binary to an output file path.
requirements: bin must be valid with pending/desired changes.
filename must be a non-NULL path string with write permissions.
Returns true on success; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_bin_lang_tostring
functions.description: Returns a string representation for a language identifier (RBinLanguage flags).
requirements: type should be one of RBinLanguage values; may be a bitmask.
Return may be NULL for unknown.

functions.name: r_bin_get_mem
functions.description: Returns a list of memory mappings (RBinMem) associated with the current binary.
requirements: bin must be valid.
Return may be NULL or empty.

functions.name: r_bin_name_new
functions.description: Creates a new RBinName with the provided name (demangled-friendly).
requirements: name may be NULL or a valid C string; copied internally if needed.
Returns NULL on allocation failure.

functions.name: r_bin_name_new_from
functions.description: Creates a new RBinName taking ownership of the provided heap-allocated name string.
requirements: name must be a heap-allocated, modifiable C string that this function may take ownership of.
Returns NULL on failure; do not free name on success (ownership transferred).

functions.name: r_bin_name_clone
functions.description: Duplicates an existing RBinName object.
requirements: bn must be a valid RBinName pointer.
Returns NULL on allocation failure.

functions.name: r_bin_name_update
functions.description: Updates the stored name inside an RBinName object.
requirements: bn must be a valid pointer to RBinName.
name must be a valid C string (copied internally).

functions.name: r_bin_name_tostring
functions.description: Returns a newly allocated string representation of the name (possibly demangled/filtered).
requirements: bn must be valid.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_name_tostring2
functions.description: Returns a string representation of the name with a specific output type/mode.
requirements: bn must be valid.
type selects which name variant to produce; specifics unspecified.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_name_demangled
functions.description: Sets the demangled name for the RBinName object.
requirements: bn must be valid.
dname must be a valid C string (copied internally).

functions.name: r_bin_name_filtered
functions.description: Sets the filtered/flag-safe name variant for the RBinName object.
requirements: bn must be valid.
fname must be a valid C string.

functions.name: r_bin_name_free
functions.description: Frees an RBinName and its owned strings.
requirements: bn may be NULL or a valid pointer.
Do not use after freeing.

functions.name: r_bin_attr_tostring
functions.description: Converts attribute flags to a textual representation; optionally condensed to single-character codes.
requirements: attr is a bitmask of attribute flags.
singlechar toggles compact output.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_attr_fromstring
functions.description: Parses a textual attribute representation into a bitmask.
requirements: s must be a non-NULL string.
compact toggles interpretation of single-character forms.
Returns a bitmask value (0 if none/parse failure).

functions.name: r_bin_load_filter
functions.description: Loads/applies symbol/section filtering rules into RBin.
requirements: bin must be valid.
rules is a bitmask of filter rules (R_BIN_REQ_* etc.).

functions.name: r_bin_filter_symbols
functions.description: Applies the configured filter to the provided list of symbols for a binfile.
requirements: bf must be valid.
list must be a list of symbols; modified in-place.

functions.name: r_bin_filter_sections
functions.description: Applies configured filters to a list of sections for a binfile.
requirements: bf must be valid.
list must be a list of sections; modified in-place.

functions.name: r_bin_filter_name
functions.signature: char *r_bin_filter_name(RBinFile *bf, HtSU *db, ut64 addr, const char *name);
functions.description: Filters/transforms a name using address and a string db, returning a new string.
requirements: bf must be valid.
db may be NULL or a valid name database.
addr is the address for context.
name must be non-NULL.
Returns allocated string or NULL; caller frees.

functions.name: r_bin_strpurge
functions.signature: bool r_bin_strpurge(RBin *bin, const char *str, ut64 addr);
functions.description: Determines whether a string should be purged (false positive) based on filters; returns true to purge.
requirements: bin must be valid.
str must be a non-NULL string.
addr provides address context.
Returns true to purge; false to keep.

functions.name: r_bin_string_filter
functions.signature: bool r_bin_string_filter(RBin *bin, const char *str, ut64 addr);
functions.description: Applies configured string filtering rules to a string; returns true if it passes the filter.
requirements: bin must be valid.
str must be non-NULL.
addr is for context.

functions.name: r_bin_xtrdata_new
functions.signature: RBinXtrData *r_bin_xtrdata_new(RBuffer *buf, ut64 offset, ut64 size, ut32 file_count, RBinXtrMetadata *metadata);
functions.description: Creates a new RBinXtrData object describing an extracted subfile/subimage from a container buffer.
requirements: buf must be a valid RBuffer referencing the container’s bytes.
offset and size define the subrange; must be within buf’s bounds.
file_count is the number of contained files; non-negative.
metadata may be NULL or a valid pointer; ownership semantics unspecified.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_xtrdata_free
functions.description: Frees an RBinXtrData passed as a generic pointer.
requirements: data may be NULL or a valid RBinXtrData pointer.
Do not use after freeing.

functions.name: r_bin_trycatch_new
functions.signature: RBinTrycatch *r_bin_trycatch_new(ut64 source, ut64 from, ut64 to, ut64 handler, ut64 filter);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a try/catch record with the given bounds, handler, and filter data.
requirements: source, from, to, handler, and filter are addresses/ids; must be valid for the binary context (no explicit constraints).
Returns NULL on allocation failure.

functions.name: r_bin_trycatch_free
functions.description: Frees a try/catch record.
requirements: tc may be NULL or a valid pointer to RBinTrycatch.
Do not use after freeing.

functions.name: r_bin_field_kindstr
functions.description: Returns a string describing the field kind (variable/field/property).
requirements: f must be a valid pointer to RBinField.
Return may be NULL for unknown kind.

functions.name: r_bin_field_new
functions.signature: RBinField *r_bin_field_new(ut64 paddr, ut64 vaddr, ut64 value, int size, const char *name, const char *comment, const char *format, bool format_named);
functions.description: Creates a new field metadata object with address, size, name, optional comment and format description.
requirements: size should be >= 0; actual constraints depend on format.
name may be NULL or a valid string.
comment and format may be NULL.
format_named indicates whether format refers to a named format or raw pf string.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_bin_field_free
functions.description: Frees a field object (RBinField) passed as a generic pointer.
requirements: Pointer may be NULL or a valid RBinField.
Do not use after freeing.

functions.name: r_reg_hasbits_check
functions.description: Checks whether the register container is configured to operate with the given bit-size. Typically used to verify that an RReg instance supports the requested register width before use.
requirements: reg must be a valid, initialized RReg pointer
size should be a positive integer representing a bit width

functions.name: r_reg_hasbits_use
functions.description: Marks or switches the register container to use the given bit-size, if supported. Useful for selecting default register size (e.g., 32 vs 64-bit).
requirements: reg must be a valid, initialized RReg pointer
size should be a positive integer representing a bit width

functions.name: r_reg_hasbits_clear
functions.description: Clears any previously set bit-size usage flags/state in the register container.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer; no operation occurs if it is NULL is not guaranteed (avoid passing NULL)

functions.name: r_reg_clone
functions.description: Creates and returns a deep clone of the provided RReg instance, including its register sets and arenas.
requirements: reg must be a valid, initialized RReg pointer
The returned RReg* must be freed with r_reg_free

functions.name: r_reg_free
functions.description: Frees all resources owned by the RReg instance, including internal lists and arenas.
requirements: reg must have been allocated/initialized by r_reg_new or r_reg_init
Do not use reg after calling this function (dangling pointer)
Safe to pass NULL is not documented; avoid passing NULL

functions.name: r_reg_new
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new RReg instance with default-initialized internal structures.
requirements: The returned pointer must be freed with r_reg_free

functions.name: r_reg_init
functions.description: Initializes an existing RReg structure for use (alternative to r_reg_new).
requirements: reg must point to writable memory large enough for RReg
Call r_reg_free to release resources initialized by this function
Do not call r_reg_init on an already initialized and in-use RReg without freeing/clearing first

functions.name: r_reg_alias_setname
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_alias_setname(RReg *reg, RRegAlias alias, const char *name);
functions.description: Assigns a register name to a standardized alias (e.g., PC, SP) within the given RReg instance.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
alias must be a valid RRegAlias enumerator
name must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string representing an existing register name in reg

functions.name: r_reg_alias_tostring
functions.description: Returns a constant string for the given alias (e.g., "pc", "sp").
requirements: alias must be a valid RRegAlias enumerator
Returned pointer is not owned by the caller and must not be freed

functions.name: r_reg_alias_getname
functions.description: Retrieves the register name currently mapped to the given standardized alias within the RReg.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
alias must be a valid RRegAlias enumerator
Returned pointer may be NULL if no mapping exists; do not free it

functions.name: r_reg_alias_fromstring
functions.description: Parses a string and returns the corresponding RRegAlias value index, enabling alias lookup by name.
requirements: type must be a non-NULL NUL-terminated string
Return value will be an integer alias id or a negative/invalid value if parsing fails (exact failure value not documented)

functions.name: r_reg_set_profile_string
functions.description: Sets the register profile on the RReg from a textual profile description string.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
profile must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string in the expected profile format for this API

functions.name: r_reg_profile_to_cc
functions.description: Generates and returns a C code representation of the current register profile for the given RReg.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
Returned string is heap-allocated; caller must free it with the appropriate deallocator used by the library (typically free)

functions.name: r_reg_set_profile
functions.description: Applies the given profile to the RReg. Similar to r_reg_set_profile_string; exact differences are not documented here.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
profile must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string in the expected profile format

functions.name: r_reg_parse_gdb_profile
functions.description: Parses a GDB-style register profile and returns a string in the library’s expected profile format.
requirements: profile must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string containing a GDB profile
Returned string is heap-allocated; caller must free it

functions.name: r_reg_ro_reset
functions.description: Resets read-only register configuration according to the provided argument string (exact semantics not documented).
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
arg must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string; accepted values/format are not documented here

functions.name: r_reg_regset_get
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the register set for the specified register type (e.g., GPR, FPU).
requirements: r must be a valid RReg pointer
type should be a valid RRegType value
Returned pointer is owned by reg; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_getv
functions.description: Gets the value of a register by its name as a 64-bit unsigned integer. Non-integer registers may be converted/unsupported depending on profile.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
name must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string naming an existing register in reg

functions.name: r_reg_setv
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_setv(RReg *reg, const char *name, ut64 val);
functions.description: Sets the value of a register by its name to the provided 64-bit value.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
name must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string naming an existing, writable register in reg

functions.name: r_reg_32_to_64
functions.description: Maps a 32-bit register name to its 64-bit counterpart according to the current profile.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
rreg32 must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string naming a 32-bit register
Returned pointer may be NULL if no mapping exists; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_64_to_32
functions.description: Maps a 64-bit register name to its 32-bit counterpart according to the current profile.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
rreg64 must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string naming a 64-bit register
Returned pointer may be NULL if no mapping exists; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_get
functions.signature: R_API RRegItem *r_reg_get(RReg *reg, const char *name, int type);
functions.description: Looks up a register item by name and type in the given RReg.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
name must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string
type should be a valid RRegType or -1 for any (per header comment R_REG_TYPE_ALL = -1)
Returned pointer may be NULL; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_get_list
functions.description: Returns a list of register items for the specified type.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
type should be a valid RRegType value or mask as used by the API
Returned list is owned by reg; treat as read-only unless documented otherwise

functions.name: r_reg_get_at
functions.signature: R_API RRegItem *r_reg_get_at(RReg *reg, int type, int regsize, int delta);
functions.description: Retrieves a register item by type and position constraints (size, delta). Exact selection semantics depend on implementation.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
type should be a valid RRegType value
regsize should be a positive bit-size
delta is an integer offset/index used by the implementation
Returned pointer may be NULL; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_next_diff
functions.signature: R_API RRegItem *r_reg_next_diff(RReg *reg, int type, const ut8 *buf, int buflen, RRegItem *prev_ri, int regsize);
functions.description: Finds the next register item of the given type whose value differs from the provided buffer snapshot, starting after prev_ri.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
buf must point to a buffer of at least buflen bytes
buflen must be non-negative
prev_ri may be NULL to start from the beginning
regsize should be a positive bit-size
Returned pointer may be NULL when no further differences are found; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_index_get
functions.description: Retrieves a register item by global index within the RReg instance.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
idx must be a non-negative index within range of existing registers
Returned pointer may be NULL; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_type_by_name
functions.description: Parses a register type name (e.g., "gpr", "fpu") and returns the corresponding RRegType index.
requirements: str must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string
Return value is an integer type id or an invalid/negative value on failure (exact error codes not documented)

functions.name: r_reg_type_tostring
functions.description: Returns the canonical string for the given register type index.
requirements: idx should be a valid RRegType index
Returned pointer may be NULL for invalid idx; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_cond
functions.description: Evaluates a condition code against the current register flags and returns whether it holds. The condition types correspond to R_REG_COND_* constants.
requirements: r must be a valid RReg pointer
type must be one of the defined R_REG_COND_* values

functions.name: r_reg_cond_get
functions.description: Gets the RRegItem representing a condition/flag register by name.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
name must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string naming a condition/flag register
Returned pointer may be NULL; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_cond_apply
functions.description: Applies the boolean values in RRegFlags to the underlying flag registers in the RReg instance.
requirements: r must be a valid RReg pointer
f must be a valid pointer to an RRegFlags struct

functions.name: r_reg_cond_set
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_cond_set(RReg *reg, const char *name, bool val);
functions.description: Sets a condition/flag register by name to the specified boolean value.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
name must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string naming a flag register

functions.name: r_reg_cond_get_value
functions.description: Retrieves the boolean value of the specified condition/flag register by name.
requirements: r must be a valid RReg pointer
name must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string naming a flag register

functions.name: r_reg_cond_bits_set
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_cond_bits_set(RReg *r, int type, RRegFlags *f, bool v);
functions.description: Sets selected condition bits (as specified by type) in the given RRegFlags structure to value v and/or commits them to the RReg depending on implementation.
requirements: r must be a valid RReg pointer
type should be a valid condition selector (e.g., one of R_REG_COND_* or a mask used by this API)
f must be a valid pointer to RRegFlags

functions.name: r_reg_cond_bits
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_cond_bits(RReg *r, int type, RRegFlags *f);
functions.description: Retrieves selected condition bits into the provided RRegFlags structure according to type.
requirements: r must be a valid RReg pointer
type should be a valid condition selector
f must be a valid pointer to RRegFlags

functions.name: r_reg_cond_retrieve
functions.description: Retrieves current CPU flag values into the provided RRegFlags and returns it.
requirements: r must be a valid RReg pointer
Second parameter must be a valid pointer to an RRegFlags struct to fill
Returned pointer equals the provided RRegFlags on success; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_get_value
functions.description: Reads the value of the specified register item as a 64-bit unsigned integer.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid RRegItem belonging to reg and referring to a scalar/integer register

functions.name: r_reg_get_value_big
functions.description: Reads the value of the specified register item, returning a 64-bit value and optionally filling a big-width value via utX (implementation-defined big integer type).
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid RRegItem belonging to reg
val must be a valid pointer to utX if used; exact size/format of utX depends on r_types and is not specified here

functions.name: r_reg_get_value_by_role
functions.description: Gets the value of the register associated with the specified alias (e.g., PC, SP).
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
alias must be a valid RRegAlias and mapped in reg

functions.name: r_reg_set_value
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_set_value(RReg *reg, RRegItem *item, ut64 value);
functions.description: Writes a 64-bit value to the specified register item.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid, writable RRegItem belonging to reg
Value is truncated/extended according to the register's size (exact behavior not documented)

functions.name: r_reg_set_value_by_role
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_set_value_by_role(RReg *reg, RRegAlias alias, ut64 value);
functions.description: Sets the value of the register currently mapped to the given alias.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
alias must be a valid RRegAlias mapped to a writable register

functions.name: r_reg_get_float
functions.description: Reads the value of a floating-point register item as a float.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid RRegItem referring to a float-capable register

functions.name: r_reg_set_float
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_set_float(RReg *reg, RRegItem *item, float value);
functions.description: Writes a float value to the specified floating-point register.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid, writable RRegItem referring to a float-capable register

functions.name: r_reg_get_double
functions.description: Reads the value of a floating-point register item as a double.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid RRegItem referring to a float-capable register

functions.name: r_reg_set_double
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_set_double(RReg *reg, RRegItem *item, double value);
functions.description: Writes a double value to the specified floating-point register.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid, writable RRegItem referring to a float-capable register

functions.name: r_reg_get_longdouble
functions.description: Reads the value of a floating-point register item as a long double.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid RRegItem referring to a float-capable register

functions.name: r_reg_set_longdouble
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_set_longdouble(RReg *reg, RRegItem *item, long double value);
functions.description: Writes a long double value to the specified floating-point register.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid, writable RRegItem referring to a float-capable register

functions.name: r_reg_get_bvalue
functions.description: Returns a string representing the boolean value of a flag/bitfield register item.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid RRegItem for a boolean/flag-like register
Returned string is heap-allocated (in typical patterns) or internal (unspecified here); ownership is not documented—check implementation

functions.name: r_reg_set_bvalue
functions.signature: R_API ut64 r_reg_set_bvalue(RReg *reg, RRegItem *item, const char *str);
functions.description: Sets a register’s boolean/bitfield value from a string representation and returns the resulting numeric value.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid, writable RRegItem for a boolean/flag-like register
str must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string

functions.name: r_reg_set_pack
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_set_pack(RReg *reg, RRegItem *item, int packidx, int packbits, ut64 val);
functions.description: Sets the value of a specific packed field within a packed register item.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid, writable RRegItem that supports packed fields (item->packed_size > 0)
packidx must be a non-negative index within the packed fields
packbits should be a positive bit-size for the packed field
val will be masked/truncated to packbits (exact behavior not documented)

functions.name: r_reg_get_pack
functions.signature: R_API ut64 r_reg_get_pack(RReg *reg, RRegItem *item, int packidx, int packbits);
functions.description: Gets the value of a specific packed field within a packed register item as an unsigned integer.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
item must be a valid RRegItem that supports packed fields
packidx must be a non-negative index within the packed fields
packbits should be a positive bit-size

functions.name: r_reg_default_bits
functions.description: Returns the default bit-size for registers in this RReg (e.g., 32 or 64).
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer

functions.name: r_reg_default_endian
functions.description: Returns the default endianness for this RReg as an integer code (implementation-specific constant).
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer

functions.name: r_reg_get_bytes
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the internal byte buffer (arena) for the specified register type and writes its size to size.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
type should be a valid RRegType
size may be NULL; if non-NULL it receives the buffer size in bytes
Returned buffer is owned by reg; do not free or write unless API allows

functions.name: r_reg_set_bytes
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_set_bytes(RReg *reg, int type, const ut8 *buf, const int len);
functions.description: Overwrites the byte arena for the specified register type with the provided buffer.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
type should be a valid RRegType
buf must point to at least len bytes
len must be non-negative and should not exceed the destination arena capacity (exact limits not documented)

functions.name: r_reg_read_regs
functions.signature: R_API bool r_reg_read_regs(RReg *reg, ut8 *buf, const int len);
functions.description: Reads all current register bytes into the provided buffer up to len bytes.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
buf must point to writable memory of at least len bytes
len must be non-negative

functions.name: r_reg_arena_set_bytes
functions.description: Sets the register arena bytes from a textual representation (e.g., hex string). Returns number of bytes written or a status code.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
str must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string in the expected byte format

functions.name: r_reg_arena_new
functions.description: Allocates a new register arena (byte buffer) of the given size.
requirements: size must be non-negative (positive to hold data)
Returned arena must be freed with r_reg_arena_free

functions.name: r_reg_arena_clone
functions.description: Creates a deep clone of the given register arena, duplicating its bytes and size.
requirements: a must be a valid RRegArena pointer
Returned arena must be freed with r_reg_arena_free

functions.name: r_reg_arena_free
functions.description: Frees a register arena previously allocated or cloned.
requirements: ra must be a pointer returned by r_reg_arena_new or r_reg_arena_clone
Do not use ra after this call

functions.name: r_reg_fit_arena
functions.description: Adjusts internal arenas to fit current register layout/profile requirements (e.g., resizing).
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer

functions.name: r_reg_arena_swap
functions.description: Swaps the current arena with a saved one; copy may control whether bytes are copied versus only swapping references.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
copy parameter meaning is implementation-defined (commonly 0/1)

functions.name: r_reg_arena_push
functions.description: Pushes the current arena state onto an internal stack, returning a handle or depth.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer

functions.name: r_reg_arena_pop
functions.description: Pops/restores the most recently pushed arena state.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
There must be a previously pushed state; behavior on underflow is unspecified

functions.name: r_reg_arena_zero
functions.description: Zeroes all bytes in the current arena(s) of the RReg.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer

functions.name: r_reg_arena_peek
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the current arena bytes and optionally the length via len without removing them.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
len may be NULL; if non-NULL receives the byte length
Returned pointer is owned by reg; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_arena_poke
functions.signature: R_API void r_reg_arena_poke(RReg *reg, const ut8 *buf, int len);
functions.description: Overwrites the current arena bytes with the provided buffer up to len bytes.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
buf must point to at least len bytes
len must be non-negative and should not exceed the destination capacity (undocumented)

functions.name: r_reg_arena_dup
functions.description: Duplicates the arena or returns a duplicate buffer based on the given source; exact semantics depend on implementation. Returns a newly allocated byte buffer.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer
source must be a valid pointer to a buffer used as duplication source (exact usage unspecified)
Returned buffer is heap-allocated; caller must free it

functions.name: r_reg_cond_tostring
functions.description: Returns the string name for a condition code number (R_REG_COND_*).
requirements: n should be within 0..R_REG_COND_LAST-1
Returned pointer is not owned by the caller; do not free

functions.name: r_reg_cond_from_string
functions.description: Parses a condition code name string and returns its numeric code.
requirements: str must be a non-NULL, NUL-terminated string
Return value is the numeric code or an invalid/negative value if parsing fails (not specified)

functions.name: r_reg_arena_shrink
functions.description: Shrinks internal arena(s) to the minimal necessary size based on current contents/layout.
requirements: reg must be a valid RReg pointer

functions.name: r_flag_get_meta
functions.description: Return the metadata associated with a flag item identified by id in the given RFlag context. Returns NULL if no metadata exists for that id.
requirements: f must be a valid, initialized RFlag* created by r_flag_new
id should correspond to an existing RFlagItem's id in f; otherwise NULL may be returned
Return may be NULL (check before use)

functions.name: r_flag_get_meta2
functions.description: Retrieve metadata for a flag item by id (variant 2). Behavior differs from r_flag_get_meta internally; exact differences are not documented here.

functions.name: r_flag_del_meta

id should correspond to an existing RFlagItem to have any effect

functions.name: r_flag_new

functions.name: r_flag_free

Do not use f after this call

functions.name: r_flag_list

addr is the address to test

functions.name: r_flag_get

name must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: r_flag_get_in

addr is an address to query
Return may be NULL if no flag covers addr

functions.name: r_flag_get_by_spaces

functions.name: r_flag_get_at

addr is the target address
closest toggles exact vs nearest search; exact semantics of proximity are not documented

pfx must be a valid, null-terminated string
addr is the center address
radius specifies the maximum distance; valid range semantics are not documented

functions.name: r_flag_all_list
functions.description: Return a list of all flags. If by_space is true, ordering/grouping may be by space.

functions.name: r_flag_get_list

functions.name: r_flag_get_liststr
functions.description: Return a textual representation of the flags at the specified address.

addr is the address to query

functions.name: r_flag_unset

functions.name: r_flag_unset_name
functions.description: Remove a flag by its name from the RFlag context.

name must be a valid, null-terminated string corresponding to an existing flag name to succeed

functions.name: r_flag_unset_addr
functions.description: Remove flags located at the exact address addr.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
addr is the target address

functions.name: r_flag_unset_all
functions.description: Remove all flags from the RFlag context.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
After this call, no flags remain; subsequent lookups will reflect the cleared state

functions.name: r_flag_set

addr is the start address of the flag

functions.name: r_flag_set_inspace

requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
space must be a valid, null-terminated string naming a space (will be created or must exist; exact behavior unknown)
name must be a valid, null-terminated string and unique within the target space/context
addr is the start address; size is the length in bytes (exact constraints unknown)
Return may be NULL on failure

functions.name: r_flag_set_next
functions.signature: RFlagItem *r_flag_set_next(RFlag *fo, const char *name, ut64 addr, ut32 size);
functions.description: Create a flag like r_flag_set, possibly adjusting name to the next available unique variant (exact semantics implied by 'next').

name must be a valid, null-terminated string
addr and size specify the flag location and length
Return may be NULL on failure

functions.name: r_flag_item_free
functions.description: Free a standalone RFlagItem object.
requirements: item may be NULL or a valid RFlagItem*
Only free items not owned by an RFlag container, unless the API explicitly returns an independent clone (ownership expectations are not documented)
Do not use item after freeing

functions.name: r_flag_item_clone
functions.description: Create a duplicate of the given flag item.
requirements: item must be a valid RFlagItem*
Caller must check return for NULL and free the clone with r_flag_item_free when done

functions.name: r_flag_item_set_type
functions.signature: const char *r_flag_item_set_type(RFlag *f, RFlagItem *fi, const char * R_NULLABLE type);
functions.description: Set or clear the type metadata string for a flag item and return the stored string pointer.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
fi must be a valid RFlagItem* associated with f
type may be NULL (to clear) or a valid, null-terminated string
Return may be NULL if cleared or on failure; do not modify returned storage directly

functions.name: r_flag_item_set_alias
functions.signature: const char *r_flag_item_set_alias(RFlag *f, RFlagItem *item, const char * R_NULLABLE alias);
functions.description: Set or clear the alias metadata for a flag item (e.g., an expression like "foo + 3"). Returns the stored string pointer.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
item must be a valid RFlagItem* associated with f
alias may be NULL (to clear) or a valid, null-terminated string
Do not modify the returned storage directly

functions.name: r_flag_item_set_comment
functions.signature: const char *r_flag_item_set_comment(RFlag *f, RFlagItem *fi, const char * R_NULLABLE comment);
functions.description: Set or clear the comment metadata string for a flag item and return the stored string pointer.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
fi must be a valid RFlagItem* associated with f
comment may be NULL (to clear) or a valid, null-terminated string
Do not modify the returned storage directly

functions.name: r_flag_item_set_realname
functions.signature: const char *r_flag_item_set_realname(RFlag *f, RFlagItem *fi, const char * R_NULLABLE realname);
functions.description: Set or clear the real (demangled/display) name metadata string for a flag item and return the stored string pointer.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
fi must be a valid RFlagItem* associated with f
realname may be NULL (to clear) or a valid, null-terminated string
Do not modify the returned storage directly

functions.name: r_flag_item_set_color
functions.signature: const char *r_flag_item_set_color(RFlag *f, RFlagItem *item, const char * R_NULLABLE color);
functions.description: Set or clear the color metadata for a flag item and return the stored string pointer.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
item must be a valid RFlagItem* associated with f
color may be NULL (to clear) or a valid, null-terminated string in an accepted color format (exact format unknown)
Do not modify the returned storage directly

functions.name: r_flag_unset_glob
functions.description: Remove flags whose names match a glob pattern.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated glob pattern string
Return value is an integer (likely count of removed flags; exact semantics not documented)

functions.name: r_flag_rename
functions.description: Rename a flag item to the specified new unique name.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
item must be a valid RFlagItem* associated with f
name must be a valid, null-terminated string and must be unique in f
Return is an int (success/error code semantics not documented)

functions.name: r_flag_relocate
functions.signature: int r_flag_relocate(RFlag *f, ut64 addr, ut64 addr_mask, ut64 to);
functions.description: Relocate flags whose addresses match addr with mask addr_mask to a new base address to.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
addr and addr_mask define a selection; exact matching semantics are not documented
to is the target address/base
Return is an int (success/error code semantics not documented)

functions.name: r_flag_move
functions.signature: bool r_flag_move(RFlag *f, ut64 at, ut64 to);
functions.description: Move flags at address at to a new address to.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
at is the source address; to is the destination address

functions.name: r_flag_count
functions.description: Count flags, optionally filtering by a glob pattern.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
glob may be NULL or a valid, null-terminated glob pattern (exact NULL handling unknown)
Return is an integer count; may be zero

functions.name: r_flag_foreach
functions.description: Iterate over all flags, invoking cb for each item with user as the context.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
cb must be a valid callback function pointer; its contract (return value meaning) is not documented here
user is an opaque pointer passed to the callback
Do not mutate the container in ways that invalidate iteration unless API guarantees safety (unknown)

functions.name: r_flag_foreach_prefix
functions.signature: void r_flag_foreach_prefix(RFlag *f, const char *pfx, int pfx_len, RFlagItemCb cb, void *user);
functions.description: Iterate over flags whose names start with the specified prefix (first pfx_len characters), invoking cb for each.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
pfx must be a valid pointer to at least pfx_len bytes; may be non-null-terminated if pfx_len is used
pfx_len specifies the prefix length; must be non-negative (exact constraints unknown)
cb must be a valid callback; user is passed through

functions.name: r_flag_foreach_range
functions.signature: void r_flag_foreach_range(RFlag *f, ut64 from, ut64 to, RFlagItemCb cb, void *user);
functions.description: Iterate over flags whose ranges intersect [from, to], invoking cb for each.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
from and to define an address interval; expected that from <= to (not enforced here)
cb must be a valid callback; user is passed through

functions.name: r_flag_foreach_glob
functions.signature: void r_flag_foreach_glob(RFlag *f, const char *glob, RFlagItemCb cb, void *user);
functions.description: Iterate over flags whose names match the provided glob pattern, invoking cb for each.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
glob must be a valid, null-terminated glob pattern string
cb must be a valid callback; user is passed through

space must be a valid RSpace* reference obtained from the same RFlag's spaces
cb must be a valid callback; user is passed through

functions.signature: void r_flag_foreach_space_glob(RFlag *f, const char *glob, const RSpace *space, RFlagItemCb cb, void *user);
functions.description: Iterate over flags in the given space whose names match glob, invoking cb for each.

glob must be a valid, null-terminated glob pattern string
space must be a valid RSpace* from f
cb must be a valid callback; user is passed through

functions.name: r_flag_space_get
functions.description: Fetch a space by name from the RFlag context (wrapper over r_spaces_get).
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated string
Return may be NULL if the space does not exist

functions.name: r_flag_space_cur
functions.description: Return the current (active) flag space for the RFlag context.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
Return may be NULL if no current space is set

functions.name: r_flag_space_cur_name
functions.description: Return the name of the current flag space. Note: comment indicates this should strdup but returns a pointer managed internally; treat as non-owned.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
Returned pointer must not be freed or modified; lifetime is tied to f and is not guaranteed beyond immediate use

functions.name: r_flag_space_set
functions.description: Set the current flag space to name, creating it if necessary (behavior per r_spaces_set). Returns the resulting space.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated string
Return may be NULL on failure (e.g., allocation failure)

functions.description: Remove the named flag space from the RFlag context.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated string
Removing the current space’s implications are not documented

functions.signature: static inline bool r_flag_space_rename(RFlag *f, const char *oname, const char *nname);
functions.description: Rename a flag space from oname to nname.

oname and nname must be valid, null-terminated strings
nname must be unique among existing spaces (implied by rename)

functions.name: r_flag_space_push
functions.signature: static inline bool r_flag_space_push(RFlag *f, const char *name);
functions.description: Push a space onto the internal space stack, making it current.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: r_flag_space_pop
functions.description: Pop the current space from the internal space stack and restore the previous one.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
There must be a space to pop; behavior if empty is defined by r_spaces_pop (unknown)

functions.name: r_flag_space_count
functions.signature: static inline int r_flag_space_count(RFlag *f, const char *name);
functions.description: Return the number of items (or references) associated with the named space (semantics per r_spaces_count).
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: r_flag_space_is_empty
functions.description: Check whether the space stack or collection is empty (per r_spaces_is_empty).
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*

functions.name: r_flag_tags_list
functions.description: List tags associated with a flag by name, or list available tags (exact semantics not fully documented).

name must be a valid, null-terminated string (may be a flag or tag name; exact meaning unknown)
Return is an RList*; element types and ownership are not documented

functions.name: r_flag_tags_set
functions.description: Assign tags to a flag or name based on words (likely space-separated). Returns a list (probably of tags).
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated string
words must be a valid, null-terminated string of tags; format semantics are not documented
Return is an RList*; ownership and element types are not documented

functions.name: r_flag_tags_reset
functions.description: Reset/clear tags associated with the given name.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated string

functions.name: r_flag_tags_get
functions.description: Fetch tags linked to the given name.
requirements: f must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated string
Return is an RList*; ownership and content types are not documented

functions.name: r_flag_zone_item_free

Do not use the object after freeing

functions.name: r_flag_zone_add
functions.signature: bool r_flag_zone_add(RFlag *fz, const char *name, ut64 addr);
functions.description: Add a zone boundary identified by name at the given address.

name must be a valid, null-terminated string
addr is the address to mark as a zone boundary

functions.name: r_flag_zone_del
functions.description: Delete a named zone.
requirements: fz must be a valid RFlag*
name must be a valid, null-terminated string corresponding to an existing zone

functions.name: r_flag_zone_get
functions.description: Get the zone item associated with the given name.

Return may be NULL if the zone is not found

functions.name: r_flag_zone_reset

functions.signature: RList *r_flag_zone_barlist(RFlag *f, ut64 from, ut64 bsize, int rows);

from is the starting address
