functions.name: r_anal_block_add_switch_case
functions.signature: void r_anal_block_add_switch_case(RAnalBlock *block, ut64 switch_addr, ut64 case_value, ut64 case_addr)
functions.description: Adds a case to a block's switch operation metadata. Creates block->switch_op if missing.
requirements: block must be valid.
switch_addr is the address of the switch instruction.
case_value is the case selector value.
case_addr is the destination address for this case.

functions.name: r_anal_block_chop_noreturn
functions.description: Chops off a block at the specified address after a noreturn call and removes all destinations. May free the block during automerge; returns block only if it remains valid, otherwise NULL.
requirements: block must be valid.
addr must be the address directly AFTER the noreturn call.
Caller must treat a NULL return as invalidated block pointer; do not use block then.

functions.name: r_anal_block_automerge
functions.description: Attempts to merge every block in the list with their contiguous predecessor where possible. Merged blocks are freed. The list is updated to keep only surviving blocks.
requirements: blocks must be a valid RList of RAnalBlock pointers.
Callers must not use pointers to blocks that were merged/freed afterwards.

functions.name: r_anal_block_op_starts_at
functions.description: Checks whether an instruction in the given block starts exactly at addr.
requirements: block must be valid.
addr is the concrete address to test.
Returns true if an instruction starts at addr; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_anal_block_update_hash
functions.description: Updates the block's hash (bbhash) based on its current bytes.
requirements: block must be valid.
Underlying bytes should be accessible via the analysis context.

functions.name: r_anal_block_was_modified
functions.description: Returns true if a byte in the given basic block was modified since last hash computation.
requirements: block must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_new
functions.description: Allocates a new function object associated with the given analysis instance.
requirements: anal must be a valid RAnal pointer.
Caller must free with r_anal_function_free or add to analysis with r_anal_add_function.

functions.name: r_anal_function_free
functions.description: Frees an RAnalFunction object not owned by the analysis database.
requirements: fcn must not be currently registered in RAnal (or caller must ensure safe removal first).
After call, fcn must not be used.

functions.name: r_anal_add_function
functions.description: Adds a function created by r_anal_function_new to the analysis database.
requirements: anal must be a valid RAnal pointer.
fcn must be a valid function not already added.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_create_function
functions.signature: RAnalFunction *r_anal_create_function(RAnal *anal, const char *name, ut64 addr, int type, RAnalDiff *diff)
functions.description: Creates a new function, initializes its members (name/address/type/diff), and adds it to the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be a valid RAnal pointer.
name must be a non-NULL function name string.
addr is the function entrypoint address.
type is a bitmask of R_ANAL_FCN_TYPE_*.
diff may be NULL or a valid RAnalDiff pointer.
Returns NULL on failure.

functions.name: r_anal_get_functions_in
functions.description: Returns all functions that have at least one basic block containing the given address.
requirements: anal must be valid.
addr is the address to test.
Caller must free the returned RList.

functions.name: r_anal_get_function_at
functions.description: Returns the function whose entrypoint is exactly at addr, or NULL if none.
requirements: anal must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_delete
functions.description: Deletes the given function from the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
fcn must be a function present in anal.
After deletion, fcn must not be used.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_function_relocate
functions.description: Changes the entrypoint address of the function. Fails if another function already exists at the target address.
requirements: fcn must be valid and already added or managed.
addr must not collide with an existing function entry.
Returns true on success, false on failure.

functions.name: r_anal_function_rename
functions.description: Renames the given function. Fails if another function already has the specified name.
requirements: fcn must be valid.
name must be a non-NULL string.
Returns true on success, false if name conflict.

functions.name: r_anal_function_add_block
functions.description: Adds a basic block to a function's set of blocks.
requirements: fcn must be valid.
bb must be a valid RAnalBlock pointer belonging to the same RAnal context.

functions.name: r_anal_function_remove_block
functions.description: Removes a basic block from a function's block set.
requirements: fcn must be valid.
bb must be valid and currently associated with fcn.

functions.name: r_anal_function_linear_size
functions.description: Returns the total size of the range spanned by the function, including holes: max_addr - min_addr.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_min_addr
functions.description: Returns the lowest address covered by the function (min of its blocks).
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_max_addr
functions.description: Returns the first address directly after the function (exclusive end of the function's covered range).
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_size_from_entry
functions.description: Returns the size from the function entrypoint (fcn->addr) to the function's max address.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_realsize
functions.description: Returns the sum of sizes of the basic blocks that compose the function (the 'real' size).
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_contains
functions.description: Returns whether the function contains a block that contains addr. Independent of fcn->addr.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_was_modified
functions.description: Returns true if function bytes have been modified since last hash/recording.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_get_graph
functions.description: Builds/returns a graph object for the function's control flow. Optionally returns a node for a given address via node_ptr.
requirements: fcn must be valid.
node_ptr may be NULL or a pointer to receive a node pointer.
addr is the address to locate a node for; ignored if node_ptr is NULL.
Caller may need to manage the returned graph per RGraph ownership rules.

functions.name: r_anal_new
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new analysis context.
requirements: Caller must free with r_anal_free.
Thread safety depends on compiled options; use provided lock if needed.

functions.name: r_anal_purge
functions.description: Clears transient analysis data (e.g., blocks, functions, caches) from the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
Existing pointers to purged objects may become invalid; do not use them afterwards.

functions.name: r_anal_free
functions.description: Frees the analysis context and all resources it owns.
requirements: r must be a valid RAnal pointer or NULL.
After call, r and all owned objects must not be used.

functions.name: r_anal_set_user_ptr
functions.description: Stores an opaque user pointer in the analysis context for client use.
requirements: anal must be valid.
user may be any value; lifetime managed by caller.

functions.name: r_anal_plugin_free
functions.description: Frees an analysis plugin instance's resources.
requirements: p must be a valid plugin pointer or NULL.
Should not be called on statically allocated plugin descriptors.

functions.name: r_anal_plugin_add
functions.description: Registers an analysis plugin with the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
plugin must be a valid plugin descriptor.
Returns 0 or positive value on success (exact semantics unknown).

functions.name: r_anal_plugin_remove
functions.description: Unregisters an analysis plugin from the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
plugin must be a previously added plugin pointer.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_archinfo
functions.description: Queries architecture-specific information from the analysis context based on query id.
requirements: anal must be valid.
query must be one of supported codes; unknown otherwise.
Returns an integer value specific to the query.

functions.name: r_anal_is_aligned
functions.description: Checks whether the given address is aligned according to the active architecture settings.
requirements: anal must be valid.
addr is the address to test.

functions.name: r_anal_use
functions.description: Selects and uses the analysis plugin identified by name.
requirements: anal must be valid.
name must match a registered plugin's name.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_set_reg_profile
functions.description: Sets the register profile (definition) for the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
rp must be a register profile string.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_get_reg_profile
functions.description: Gets the current register profile as a string. Caller owns the returned string.
requirements: anal must be valid.
Caller must free the returned string.

functions.name: r_anal_get_bbaddr
functions.description: Returns the starting address of the basic block containing addr, or possibly 0/UT64_MAX if none.
requirements: anal must be valid.
addr is the address to query.

functions.name: r_anal_set_bits
functions.description: Sets the active analysis bitness (e.g., 16/32/64).
requirements: anal must be valid.
bits must be supported by the selected architecture.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_set_os
functions.description: Sets the operating system target for the analysis context (affects conventions, etc.).
requirements: anal must be valid.
os must be a non-NULL string identifying a supported OS.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_mask
functions.signature: ut8 *r_anal_mask(RAnal *anal, int size, const ut8 *data, ut64 at)
functions.description: Returns a mask buffer derived from given data and address, useful for pattern matching/fingerprints. Exact semantics depend on plugin.
requirements: anal must be valid.
size must be >= 0.
data must point to at least size bytes.
Returned buffer ownership belongs to caller; must be freed per implementation rules.

functions.name: r_anal_trace_bb
functions.description: Marks/traces the basic block at the given address for analysis coverage or tracing features.
requirements: anal must be valid.
addr is an address inside or at the start of a basic block.

functions.name: r_anal_functiontype_tostring
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string for a function type bitmask (R_ANAL_FCN_TYPE_*).
requirements: type should be a valid combination of R_ANAL_FCN_TYPE_* bits.
Returned string is likely static; do not free.

functions.name: r_anal_function_coverage
functions.description: Computes coverage percentage or count for a function (implementation-defined metric).
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_bb
functions.signature: int r_anal_function_bb(RAnal *anal, RAnalFunction *fcn, ut64 addr, int depth)
functions.description: Performs basic block analysis for the function starting from addr to a specified recursion depth.
requirements: anal must be valid.
fcn must be valid and associated with anal.
addr is a starting address inside the function.
depth controls recursion; non-negative.

functions.name: r_anal_bind
functions.description: Populates a binding structure with analysis API function pointers for plugin use.
requirements: b must be valid.
bnd must be a valid pointer to an RAnalBind to fill.

functions.name: r_anal_type_match
functions.description: Performs type matching/inference for the given function within the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
fcn must be valid and belong to anal.

functions.name: r_anal_set_triplet
functions.signature: bool r_anal_set_triplet(RAnal *anal, const char *os, const char *arch, int bits)
functions.description: Sets the OS/architecture/bits triplet for the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
os and arch must be non-NULL supported identifiers.
bits must be supported for the arch.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_add_import
functions.description: Registers an import (external symbol) name globally within the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
imp must be a non-NULL string.

functions.name: r_anal_remove_import
functions.description: Removes a previously registered import name from the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
imp must be a non-NULL string matching an existing import.

functions.name: r_anal_purge_imports
functions.description: Clears all globally registered imports from the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
Pointers to previous imports become invalid after purge.

functions.name: r_anal_bb_from_offset
functions.description: Returns the basic block that contains the given offset/address, or NULL.
requirements: anal must be valid.
off is the address to query.

functions.name: r_anal_bb_set_offset
functions.signature: bool r_anal_bb_set_offset(RAnalBlock *bb, int i, ut16 v)
functions.description: Sets the i-th instruction offset marker in the block to v (legacy layout).
requirements: bb must be valid.
i must be within the op_pos array bounds for the block.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_bb_offset_inst
functions.description: Gets the i-th instruction offset (relative within the block).
requirements: bb must be valid.
i must be in range.

functions.name: r_anal_bb_opaddr_i
functions.description: Returns the absolute address of the i-th instruction inside the block.
requirements: bb must be valid.
i must be in range.

functions.name: r_anal_bb_opaddr_at
functions.description: Returns the absolute address of the instruction that starts at addr within the block (likely echoing addr) or nearest match depending on implementation.
requirements: bb must be valid.
addr should correspond to an instruction start inside the block.

functions.name: r_anal_bb_size_i
functions.description: Returns the size (in bytes) of the i-th instruction inside the block.
requirements: bb must be valid.
i must be in range.

functions.name: r_anal_stackop_tostring
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string for a stack operation code.
requirements: s must be a valid stack operation enum/int value recognized by the implementation.
Returned string is likely static; do not free.

functions.name: r_anal_op_new
functions.description: Allocates a new RAnalOp (analysis op) structure.
requirements: Caller must free with r_anal_op_free or r_anal_op_fini + free as appropriate.

functions.name: r_anal_op_free
functions.description: Frees an RAnalOp allocated by r_anal_op_new. Accepts void* for generic freeing.
requirements: op must be NULL or a pointer returned by r_anal_op_new.

functions.name: r_anal_op_init
functions.description: Initializes an RAnalOp structure to default/empty state.
requirements: op must be a valid pointer to allocated memory for RAnalOp.
Caller must later call r_anal_op_fini to release internal resources if any.

functions.name: r_anal_op_fini
functions.description: Finalizes an RAnalOp, releasing internal resources without freeing the structure itself.
requirements: op must be a valid pointer previously initialized by r_anal_op_init or filled by r_anal_op.
After fini, op can be reused or freed by caller.

functions.name: r_anal_mnemonics
functions.description: Returns a string with instruction mnemonic(s) for the given id. If json is true, returns a JSON-formatted string.
requirements: anal must be valid.
id is instruction id for the current arch.
Caller owns and must free the returned string.

functions.name: r_anal_op_reg_delta
functions.signature: int r_anal_op_reg_delta(RAnal *anal, ut64 addr, const char *name)
functions.description: Computes the delta/change applied to a specific register by the instruction at addr.
requirements: anal must be valid.
addr is the address of the instruction to analyze.
name must be the register name string.
Returns an integer delta; semantics depend on arch.

functions.name: r_anal_op_is_eob
functions.description: Returns true if the operation is an End-Of-Block (e.g., unconditional jump/return).
requirements: op must be a valid pointer to a decoded operation.

functions.name: r_anal_op
functions.signature: int r_anal_op(RAnal *anal, RAnalOp *op, ut64 addr, const ut8 *data, int len, RAnalOpMask mask)
functions.description: Decodes/analyzes an instruction at addr with the given bytes into op using the active analysis plugin. Returns the instruction length or a status code.
requirements: anal must be valid and configured with arch/bits.
op must be a valid pointer and will be written by the call.
data must point to at least len bytes of code at addr.
len should be >= 0 and sufficient for decoding.
mask selects analysis detail (RAnalOpMask).

functions.name: r_anal_opasm
functions.signature: int r_anal_opasm(RAnal *anal, ut64 pc, const char *s, ut8 *outbuf, int outlen)
functions.description: Assembles a textual instruction s at pc into outbuf for the active arch. Returns number of bytes written or negative on error.
requirements: anal must be valid and assembled arch supports opasm.
s must be non-NULL assembly string.
outbuf must point to a buffer of size outlen >= 0.
pc is the program counter for relative encodings.

functions.name: r_anal_op_tostring
functions.description: Returns a textual representation of the analyzed operation (disassembly string).
requirements: anal must be valid.
op must be a valid decoded operation.
Caller owns and must free the returned string.

functions.name: r_anal_pin_init
functions.description: Initializes the pin (named markers) subsystem within the analysis context.
requirements: a must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_pin_fini
functions.description: Finalizes and frees resources used by the pin subsystem.
requirements: a must be valid.
Pins and related data may be cleared; do not access after fini.

functions.name: r_anal_pin
functions.signature: void r_anal_pin(RAnal *a, ut64 addr, const char *name)
functions.description: Sets a named pin/marker at the given address.
requirements: a must be valid.
name must be a non-NULL string.
addr is the address to tag.

functions.name: r_anal_pin_call
functions.description: Gets the name of the pin/marker associated with the given call address, if any.
requirements: a must be valid.
addr is the call site address.
Returned string is likely owned by context; do not free.

functions.name: r_anal_pin_list
functions.description: Lists all pins/markers in the analysis context (prints to console/output).
requirements: a must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_pin_unset
functions.description: Removes any pin/marker at the given address.
requirements: a must be valid.
addr is the address to clear.

functions.name: r_anal_function_cost
functions.description: Computes a cost metric (e.g., complexity/size) for a function.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_count_edges
functions.description: Counts control-flow edges in a function, optionally returning the number of entry blocks (ebbs) via pointer.
requirements: fcn must be valid.
ebbs may be NULL or a valid pointer to receive the value.

functions.name: r_anal_get_function_byname
functions.description: Looks up a function by its name in the analysis database.
requirements: anal must be valid.
name must be a non-NULL string.
Returns NULL if not found.

functions.name: r_anal_function
functions.signature: int r_anal_function(RAnal *anal, RAnalFunction *fcn, ut64 addr, int reftype)
functions.description: Performs function analysis starting at addr, populating/using fcn. reftype controls how references are treated.
requirements: anal must be valid.
fcn must be a valid function and associated with anal.
addr is a starting address.
reftype must be a valid reference type mask (RAnalRefType).

functions.name: r_anal_function_del
functions.description: Deletes the function whose entrypoint is at addr.
requirements: anal must be valid.
addr must match an existing function entry.

functions.name: r_anal_function_add_bb
functions.signature: bool r_anal_function_add_bb(RAnal *anal, RAnalFunction *fcn, ut64 addr, ut64 size, ut64 jump, ut64 fail, RAnalDiff *diff)
functions.description: Adds a basic block with given properties to a function within the analysis context.
requirements: anal must be valid.
fcn must be valid and belong to anal.
addr/size define the block range; must not overlap existing blocks improperly.
jump and fail are successor addresses (0 if none).
diff may be NULL.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_check_fcn
functions.signature: bool r_anal_check_fcn(RAnal *anal, ut8 *buf, ut16 bufsz, ut64 addr, ut64 low, ut64 high)
functions.description: Heuristically checks if there is a function at addr using bytes in buf within bounds [low, high].
requirements: anal must be valid.
buf must point to at least bufsz bytes corresponding to content at addr.
low <= addr < high should hold for valid checks.
Returns true if likely a function.

functions.name: r_anal_function_check_bp_use
functions.description: Analyzes function to check for base pointer (BP) frame usage.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_update_analysis_range
functions.signature: void r_anal_update_analysis_range(RAnal *anal, ut64 addr, int size)
functions.description: Updates the internal analysis range cache to include [addr, addr+size).
requirements: anal must be valid.
size should be >= 0.

functions.name: r_anal_function_update_analysis
functions.description: Marks/updates a function as having changed and updates associated analysis caches.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_var_del_byindex
functions.signature: int r_anal_function_var_del_byindex(RAnal *a, ut64 fna, const char kind, int scope, ut32 idx)
functions.description: Deletes a variable by index within a function identified by address with kind/scope filters.
requirements: a must be valid.
fna is the function address (entrypoint).
kind is a character denoting kind (e.g., R_ANAL_FCN_VARKIND_LOCAL).
scope and idx must match an existing variable.
Returns 0 or error/success code (semantics unknown).

functions.name: r_anal_var_count
functions.signature: int r_anal_var_count(RAnal *a, RAnalFunction *fcn, int kind, int type)
functions.description: Counts variables in a function filtered by kind and type.
requirements: a must be valid.
fcn must be valid.
kind and type filter semantics depend on API; pass -1 to not filter where supported.

functions.name: r_anal_var_count_all
functions.description: Counts all variables (locals + args) in the function.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_var_count_args
functions.description: Counts argument variables for the function.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_var_count_locals
functions.description: Counts local (non-argument) variables for the function.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_var_display
functions.description: Displays/prints variable information via the analysis context output subsystem.
requirements: anal must be valid.
var must be a valid variable pointer from a function.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_function_complexity
functions.description: Computes a cyclomatic complexity or similar metric for the function.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_loops
functions.description: Counts the number of loops detected in the function.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_trim_jmprefs
functions.description: Trims/cleans jump references in the function to remove redundant or invalid references.
requirements: anal must be valid.
fcn must be valid and belong to anal.

functions.name: r_anal_del_jmprefs
functions.description: Deletes jump references in the function.
requirements: anal must be valid.
fcn must be valid and belong to anal.

functions.name: r_anal_function_next
functions.description: Returns the next function after addr (by address ordering), or NULL.
requirements: anal must be valid.
addr is the reference address.

functions.name: r_anal_function_get_signature
functions.description: Retrieves a signature string of the function (prototype), caller-owned.
requirements: function must be valid.
Caller must free the returned string.

functions.name: r_anal_function_del_signature
functions.description: Deletes a stored function signature by name from the analysis context.
requirements: a must be valid.
name must be a non-NULL function name string.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_str_to_fcn
functions.description: Parses a function description string and applies it to f within context a.
requirements: a must be valid.
f must be valid.
_str must be a non-NULL description string.
Returns 0/negative on error (exact semantics unknown).

functions.name: r_anal_function_count
functions.signature: int r_anal_function_count(RAnal *a, ut64 from, ut64 to)
functions.description: Counts functions whose addresses fall within [from, to).
requirements: a must be valid.
from <= to.

functions.name: r_anal_function_bbget_in
functions.description: Returns a basic block from fcn that contains addr, or NULL.
requirements: anal must be valid.
fcn must be valid and belong to anal.

functions.name: r_anal_function_bbget_at
functions.description: Returns a basic block from fcn that starts exactly at addr, or NULL.
requirements: anal must be valid.
fcn must be valid and belong to anal.

functions.name: r_anal_function_bbadd
functions.description: Adds an existing block to the function.
requirements: fcn must be valid.
bb must be valid and not already added to fcn.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_function_resize
functions.description: Adjusts internal representation size limits for the function; exact semantics context-dependent.
requirements: fcn must be valid.
newsize should be non-negative.

functions.name: r_anal_function_purity
functions.description: Determines whether the function is pure (no side effects) based on analysis.
requirements: fcn must be valid.
Returns true if pure; false otherwise.

functions.name: r_anal_function_instrcount
functions.description: Returns the number of instructions in the function (sum over blocks).
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_function_islineal
functions.description: Returns whether the function is linear (no branches), i.e., single basic block or straight-line code.
requirements: fcn must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_pin_get
functions.description: Resolves the address/name for a pin identifier; returns a string representation.
requirements: a must be valid.
name must be a non-NULL pin name.
Returned pointer likely owned by context; do not free.

functions.name: r_anal_pin_at
functions.description: Returns the pin name at the given address, if any.
requirements: a must be valid.
addr is the address to query.
Returned string is owned by context; do not free.

functions.name: r_anal_fcn_prefix_at
functions.description: Returns the function name prefix at the given address (for dynamic naming).
requirements: anal must be valid.
addr is the address to query.
Returned pointer is non-NULL per annotation; do not free.

functions.name: r_anal_pin_set
functions.signature: bool r_anal_pin_set(RAnal *a, const char *name, const char *cmd)
functions.description: Associates a pin with a command/action.
requirements: a must be valid.
name and cmd must be non-NULL strings.
Returns true on success.

functions.name: r_anal_ref_list_new
functions.description: Creates a new list to hold references (RAnalRef).
requirements: Caller must free the RList when done.

functions.name: r_anal_ref_type_tostring
functions.description: Returns a string describing a reference type (code/data/call/etc.).
requirements: t must be a valid RAnalRefType bitmask.
Returned string likely static; do not free.

functions.name: r_anal_ref_size
functions.description: Returns the size (bytes) of the reference (decoded from type size bits).
requirements: ref must be valid.
Returns a size value in bytes (1/2/4/8) or 0 if unknown.

functions.name: r_anal_ref_typemask
functions.description: Normalizes or extracts the reference type mask from an integer value.
requirements: x must encode a reference type and flags.
Returns a masked type int.

functions.name: r_anal_xrefs_type
functions.description: Deprecated: converts a type character to RAnalRefType.
requirements: Prefer r_anal_xrefs_type_from_string for new code.
ch must be a valid type char.

functions.name: r_anal_ref_perm_tostring
functions.description: Returns a string for the permission/direction of the reference (read/write/exec).
requirements: ref must be valid.
Returned string likely static; do not free.

functions.name: r_anal_ref_perm_tochar
functions.description: Returns a single character representing the permission/direction of the reference.
requirements: ref must be valid.

functions.name: r_anal_ref_permchar_tostring

functions.name: r_core_task_scheduler_init
functions.description: Initialize a task scheduler structure for a given RCore instance. Sets up internal queues, locks, and default mode so tasks can be submitted and run.
requirements: tasks must be a valid, writable RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
core must be a valid RCore pointer associated with the scheduler.
Must be called before using the scheduler with any other r_core_task_* APIs.
Not thread-safe to call concurrently on the same scheduler instance.

functions.name: r_core_task_scheduler_fini
functions.description: Finalize and tear down a previously initialized task scheduler, releasing its resources and internal data structures.
requirements: tasks must be a valid RCoreTaskScheduler pointer that was previously initialized with r_core_task_scheduler_init.
Must not be called concurrently with other operations on the same scheduler.
After this call, the scheduler pointer must not be used with r_core_task_* APIs unless re-initialized.

functions.name: r_core_task_get
functions.description: Look up and return a task by its ID from the given scheduler.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
id must refer to a task known by the scheduler; otherwise NULL may be returned.
Returned pointer must be considered non-owning; do not free unless explicitly documented elsewhere.

functions.name: r_core_task_running_tasks_count
functions.description: Return the number of tasks that are currently running in the scheduler.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.

functions.name: r_core_task_status
functions.description: Return a human-readable string describing the current state of the given task (e.g., before start, running, sleeping, done).
requirements: task must be a valid RCoreTask pointer.
The returned string is not owned by the caller and must not be modified or freed.

functions.name: r_core_task_new
functions.signature: RCoreTask *r_core_task_new(RCore *core, RCoreTaskMode mode, bool create_cons, const char *cmd, RCoreTaskCallback cb, void *user);
functions.description: Create a new task associated with the provided core, using the specified execution mode. Optionally associates a command string and/or a callback with user data.
requirements: core must be a valid RCore pointer.
mode must be a valid RCoreTaskMode value.
cmd, if non-NULL, must be a valid NUL-terminated string.
cb may be NULL if no callback is desired; if non-NULL, it must be callable with the provided user pointer.
The returned task must be managed (enqueued/run and eventually freed) by the caller.

functions.name: r_core_task_enqueue
functions.description: Enqueue a task for execution by the scheduler, placing it into the scheduler's task queue according to its configuration.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
task must be a valid RCoreTask pointer created for a compatible core.
Do not enqueue a task that has been freed or is currently running.

functions.name: r_core_task_run_sync
functions.description: Run the given task synchronously within the scheduler context, blocking until it completes. Returns an implementation-defined status code.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
task must be a valid RCoreTask pointer that is not already running.
Caller should check the return value for success/failure as defined by the implementation.

functions.name: r_core_task_sync_begin
functions.description: Begin a synchronous execution phase on the scheduler, preparing it for operations that require exclusive or coordinated access.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
Intended to be paired with r_core_task_sync_end; ensure balanced begin/end calls.

functions.name: r_core_task_sync_end
functions.description: End a previously started synchronous execution phase on the scheduler.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
Must only be called after a matching r_core_task_sync_begin on the same scheduler.

functions.name: r_core_task_yield
functions.description: Yield execution in cooperative mode to allow other tasks managed by the scheduler to run.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
Should be called from within a task running cooperatively; semantics in other modes may be undefined.

functions.name: r_core_task_sleep_begin
functions.description: Mark the task as entering a sleeping state (e.g., blocking or waiting), adjusting its scheduler-visible state accordingly.
requirements: task must be a valid RCoreTask pointer.
Should be paired with r_core_task_sleep_end to restore the previous state.

functions.name: r_core_task_sleep_end
functions.description: Mark the task as leaving the sleeping state, returning to runnable or appropriate state.
requirements: task must be a valid RCoreTask pointer.
Should only be called after r_core_task_sleep_begin for the same task.

functions.name: r_core_task_del
functions.description: Delete (remove) the task with the specified ID from the scheduler. Returns an implementation-defined status code.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
id must refer to a task tracked by the scheduler.
Caller should handle the return value to detect success/failure.

functions.name: r_core_task_del_all_done
functions.description: Delete all tasks in the scheduler that have reached a completed ('done') state.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.

functions.name: r_core_task_self
functions.description: Return the task object representing the currently running task within the given scheduler context.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
Must be called from a thread/context managed by the scheduler for a meaningful result.

functions.name: r_core_task_join
functions.description: Block the current task until the task with the specified ID completes.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
current must be the valid RCoreTask pointer representing the calling task.
id must refer to a task managed by the scheduler.

functions.name: r_core_task_set_foreground
functions.description: Designate a task as the foreground task, typically used as the target for user interrupts (e.g., Ctrl-C).
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
task_id must refer to a valid task in the scheduler, or a specific sentinel if supported by implementation (unspecified here).

functions.name: r_core_task_get_foreground
functions.description: Retrieve the task currently designated as the foreground task for the scheduler.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
Returned pointer is non-owning and must not be freed by the caller.

functions.name: r_core_task_set_default_mode
functions.description: Set the scheduler's default execution mode for subsequently created or submitted tasks.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
mode must be a valid RCoreTaskMode value.

functions.name: r_core_task_get_default_mode
functions.description: Return the scheduler's current default execution mode.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.

functions.name: r_core_task_run
functions.description: Run the given task according to the specified mode, returning an implementation-defined status code. This may dispatch the task cooperatively, on a thread, or via fork depending on mode.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
task must be a valid RCoreTask pointer not already running.
mode must be a valid mode value accepted by the implementation (typically aligned with RCoreTaskMode).
Caller should check the return value to detect success/failure.

functions.name: r_core_task_run_threaded
functions.description: Run the task using a threaded execution mode, returning an implementation-defined status code.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
task must be a valid RCoreTask pointer not already running.
Caller should check the return value to detect success/failure.

functions.name: r_core_task_run_forked
functions.description: Run the task in a separate process (forked) with inter-process communication as needed. Returns an implementation-defined status code.
requirements: scheduler must be a valid, initialized RCoreTaskScheduler pointer.
task must be a valid RCoreTask pointer not already running.
Caller should check the return value to detect success/failure.

functions.name: r_core_task_submit
functions.signature: RCoreTask *r_core_task_submit(RCore *core, const char *cmd, RCoreTaskCallback cb, void *user, bool capture_cons, int mode);
functions.description: Convenience API to create and submit a task for the given core with an optional command, callback, console capture, and execution mode. Returns the created task handle.
requirements: core must be a valid RCore pointer.
cmd, if non-NULL, must be a valid NUL-terminated string.
cb may be NULL; if non-NULL it must be callable with the provided user pointer.
capture_cons selects whether to capture console output; the effect is implementation-defined.
mode must be a valid mode value accepted by the implementation (typically aligned with RCoreTaskMode).
Returned task must eventually be waited on/cancelled/freed by the caller per lifecycle expectations.

functions.name: r_core_task_id
functions.description: Return the integer identifier of the given task.
requirements: t must be a valid RCoreTask pointer.

functions.name: r_core_task_wait
functions.description: Wait for the task to complete, blocking up to timeout_ms milliseconds. Returns true if the task finished within the timeout, false otherwise.
requirements: t must be a valid RCoreTask pointer.
timeout_ms is an unsigned 64-bit timeout value; behavior for special values (e.g., 0 or infinity) is implementation-defined.

functions.name: r_core_task_cancel
functions.description: Request cancellation of the given task. If hard is true, a stronger/forceful cancellation is requested; otherwise a cooperative/soft cancellation is requested. Returns true on success, false on failure/unsupported.
requirements: t must be a valid RCoreTask pointer.
hard selects the cancellation mode; exact semantics are implementation-defined.
Caller should handle the boolean return to detect whether cancellation was accepted/performed.

functions.name: r_core_task_cancel_all
functions.description: Request cancellation of all tasks associated with the given core. The hard flag requests a stronger/forceful cancellation where supported.
requirements: core must be a valid RCore pointer.

functions.name: r_core_task_free
